a-card-a-player-may-look-at-for-a-while.how: Lumbering Laundry's 'until end of turn, you may look at face-down creatures you don't control any time' is a lasting look at an open set of face-down permanents. look_at is for cards in exile and lasts from now on (seen_by has no end, and is for exile only). Add a player rule 'may look at face-down permanents [filter]' with an Expiry.
a-card-a-player-may-look-at-for-a-while.partial: Only cards exiled by the effect: a look at a hidden card elsewhere (a library card) has no seen_by span I checked. The one-call helper takes the library top only.

a-card-exiled-to-pay-a-permanent-spell-s.how: CR 607.2q: cards exiled to pay a permanent spell's cost are 'exiled with' the permanent it becomes. Cantrip links none: pay_permanents exiles a spell's cost cards with no link ('A spell's are not'), pay_exiles links nothing, only behold links (pay_behold); its own docs list this as KI-145. Pass the spell's Linked (text_linked of the spell, followed by ExileLink::is_by_in onto the permanent) when a spell's cost exiles.
a-card-exiled-to-pay-a-permanent-spell-s.note: Fear of Abduction, Redemptor Dreadnought. Gorex, Olag and Mechtitan Core stay on exile-cost-an-ability-reads-as-exiled-with-its-source.

a-card-played-from-among-those-exiled-wi.how: Landed for 'exiled with this': the spell's or land's old object, from the move out of exile, keeps its ExileLink, tested with is_by_in(linked_to(asker)).
a-card-played-from-among-those-exiled-wi.note: Voltaic Visionary (scenarios for a land and a spell pass); Prowl holds only on engine forms now.

a-card-put-onto-the-stack-as-a-copy-of-t.how: Cast-free move of an exiled card back onto the stack as a copy of the spell it was (Ertai's Meddling: 'put it onto the stack as a copy of the spell with its original targets'): copy_spell copies a spell on the stack and create_copy_in_exile makes a copy in exile; nothing puts a card from exile onto the stack as a copy of a spell that has left it, with its old targets. Add Game::stack_as_copy_of(card, spell_as_it_was, controller).
a-card-put-onto-the-stack-as-a-copy-of-t.note: Ertai's Meddling (held first on the each-step delayed ability).

a-card-type-shared-among-the-cards-used-.how: Apex Observatory: 'choose a card type shared among two exiled cards used to craft it' must offer only the types its exiled craft materials share (CR 702.167). Cantrip's as-enters choices are choose::option_as_enters over a static label range of the CardDef, and it has no as-enters choice among card types worked out at that point. Needs a choose::card_type_as_enters(g, entering, &[CardType]) that keeps the type the way chosen_option does, plus a read of it.
a-card-type-shared-among-the-cards-used-.note: Its card also holds craft-materials-that-must-have-something-in-common and operation-effect-on.

a-choice-among-costs-to-pay-each-one-ask.how: Landed (lane g15): 'its controller may pay {1} or {2}. If that player doesn't...' is each payment a may of its own (g.may_pay, CR 118.12) asked in turn, with the last option what follows when none is paid, no ChooseOne asked first.

a-choice-between-the-costs-of-an-activat.how: An activated ability has one Cost; a choice of costs exists only for spells (additional_choice). Bullseye, Death Dealer; Ion Storm (one of two counter kinds, CountersAmong takes one kind); Rift Elemental (a time counter from a permanent or a suspended card: no cost removes counters from an exiled card). Splitting into two abilities (Transmogrant's Crown) needs printed wording that names each cost apart.
a-choice-between-the-costs-of-an-activat.note: Razorfield Ripper's 'Reconfigure—Pay {2} or {E}{E}{E}' is worded apart and lands as reconfigure's two abilities at each price; Dragon's Fire is held by engine-no-reveal-cost.

a-choice-of-ability.how: Gabriel Angelfire chooses among flying, first strike, trample and rampage 3: the rampage choice needs a new module rampage in cantrip-mechanics (engine-no-rampage); the others are keywords.

a-choice-of-ability-outside-its-body.how: Most: a local (Harsh Mercy, Patriarch's Bidding, Phyrexian Splicer, Urza's Avenger, Gabriel Angelfire: choose then AddKeywords with UntilNextTurnOf). As it enters: chosen_subtype (Riptide Replicator, Volrath's Laboratory).
a-choice-of-ability-outside-its-body.note: Lane g16 did not land it (out of time); the read sits inside other holes of the same card. Akroma Avatar is a vanguard (no CardType in Cantrip); Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant is held by its engine holes (LivingMetal, MoreThanMeetsTheEye) and operation-choose-at-random; Gabriel Angelfire by a-choice-of-ability and duration-until-next-upkeep.
a-choice-of-ability-outside-its-body.partial: Across abilities after entry (A Killer Among Us, Oko, Psychic Paper, Seshiro): gap as a-choice row.

a-choice-of-card-name-outside-its-body.note: gap only for the Conspiracy layout.
a-choice-of-card-name-outside-its-body.partial: 14 are Conspiracies: hidden agenda needs a zone and pre-game choice: unsupported, unplayable. Others: Garth One-Eye: remember_chosen_name, exists. Conundrum Sphinx: a local. Null Chamber: two chosen names, Entering holds one but CHOSEN_NAMES per ability gives a second by remember_chosen_name after e

a-choice-of-card-type.how: labels: &["Artifact",..] and choose::option_as_enters / choose::one_of; read choose::chosen_option; map index to CardType by a const array.
a-choice-of-card-type.note: Tracker read a RequestKind as needed; none needed.

a-choice-of-card-type-outside-its-body.how: Landed for 'as this enters, choose a card type other than creature' (Stenn, Paranoid Partisan): the other types are its labels, picked with choose::option_as_enters as Arachne does, and read back as its chosen option. Apex Observatory's choice among the types its craft materials share moved to a-card-type-shared-among-the-cards-used-to-craft-it, and its read of that choice now follows it.
a-choice-of-card-type-outside-its-body.note: Stenn is whole and compiles. Its content JSON was made with new-card.py, and it has no scenarios.

a-choice-of-color-and-creature-type.how: Landed: the printed pairs are the card's labels, chosen with choose::option_as_enters and kept as its chosen color and chosen subtype (Sarpadian Empires, Vol. VII).

a-choice-of-color-made-again.partial: choices written only as it enters.

a-choice-of-color-outside-its-body.how: Chosen in the same resolution: local (Apostle's Blessing, Razor Barrier, Jeweled Spirit, Territorial Hellkite, Strax). "Sources of the chosen color" (Prismatic Strands, Avacyn): five entries in granted_preventions, index = color. As it enters: entering.chosen_color/chosen_player then q.state().chosen_*(q.linked_to(..)) (Riptide Replicator, Sarpadian Empires, Volrath's Laboratory). Mana (Corrupted Grafstone, Meteor Crater): colors_from.
a-choice-of-color-outside-its-body.note: Lane g14: no card holds it. A color chosen by what is itself a hole of the card (a commander's color before the game, ChooseProtection, a color chosen as an Equipment becomes attached) is read as following that hole.
a-choice-of-color-outside-its-body.partial: Apostle's Blessing, Jeweled Spirit, Razor Barrier follow keyword-action-choose-protection; Clara Oswald, Faceless One, The Prismatic Piper follow a-deck-rule-a-commander-sets; Sanctuary Blade follows ability AsEvent.

a-choice-of-creature-type-outside-its-bo.how: Engine, for the cards left: a creature type chosen in one ability and read by another, or chosen as a cost and kept by the permanent, has no store. Choices keeps only as-enters values (object.rs:225); StackItem::choice holds only behold's announced type, for the spell itself (object.rs:1080). A Killer Among Us (a type chosen as it enters, read by a later ability with a revealed choice), Caller of the Hunt (chosen as an additional cost, read by the permanent), Psychic Paper (ability-as-event), Seshiro (vanguard). Earlier cases in one body landed (chosen_type.rs:40).
a-choice-of-creature-type-outside-its-bo.note: Celestial Reunion's read is the type announced with behold, which StackItem::choice (object.rs:1080) carries; it holds on cost-part-behold and cost-part-player-action.

a-choice-of-direction.how: Generator writes it (lane g16): left or right is choose::option_as_enters(g, entering, &CARD, 0..2) with labels ["left", "right"], and "the opponent nearest in the chosen direction" reads q.state().chosen_option(q.linked_to(source)) and walks q.state().turn_order_from(p), reversed for right (Pramikon, Sky Rampart).
a-choice-of-direction.note: No cards left: Pramikon holds only player-rule-attack-only.

a-choice-of-planeswalker-type.how: ChooseSubtype choices: a const list of planeswalker Subtypes.

a-choice-of-planeswalker-type-outside-it.how: No card left: Leori is split onto a-resolution-s-choice-read-by-the-trigger-it-creates.

a-choice-of-player-outside-its-body.how: Beckoning Will-o'-Wisp and Triarch Stalker read 'the last chosen player'. There is no remember_chosen for players.
a-choice-of-player-outside-its-body.partial: Remembered after entering by a later ability (Beckoning Will-o'-Wisp, Triarch Stalker, Faramir, Sanctuary Blade, schemes Bow to My Command): ChoiceRecord writes only as it enters and remember_chosen_name: gap, 8 cards. Commander pre-game color (3 cards): gap.

a-choice-of-recipient.how: Lands as a choice when it resolves. The lane-N test that named it a requirement now checks for the choice (Vial Smasher the Fierce).

a-choice-of-several-values.how: Kept choices land. Zombie Boa and Leori: a delayed trigger keeps no value. Phyrexian Splicer: a choice made in a cost is read by a target filter. Faceless One, Clara Oswald and Prismatic Piper: deck-building rules. Riptide Replicator, Volrath's Laboratory and Sarpadian Empires: a token of the chosen color. Oko's emblem keeps no value. Apostle's Blessing, Razor Barrier and Jeweled Spirit belong to another lane. Illusionary Terrain is not done.
a-choice-of-several-values.partial: Kept after entry: gap. Two values of one kind as it enters: encode the second in Entering.chosen_number (see condition-value-chosen-is).

a-chosen-card-type-where-its-body-chose-.how: Karona, False God: "choose a creature type. Creatures of the chosen type get +3/+3" reads IsCardtypeVariable(TheChosenCardtype) after ChooseACreatureType. Proposed: IsCreatureTypeVariable(TheChosenCreatureType).

a-chosen-object-outside-its-body.how: Koh, the Face Stealer reads 'the last chosen card' from a static ability after its triggered ability exiled and chose it. A resolving ability can remember only a name (remember_chosen_name); chosen_object is written only as the permanent enters.

a-copy-of-a-spell-for-each-object-it-cou.how: No public query of what a stack item's target slot could target: `item_target_candidates` (actions.rs:1731) and `slot_spec` (resolve.rs:85) are crate-private, and `can_target` is only hexproof and protection. Copying first and then `change_a_target_to` leaves a copy on its old target where the new one is illegal, and that call only takes a permanent. Needs `Query::target_candidates(item, slot)` (or `copy_spell_targeting(spell, copier, to)`).
a-copy-of-a-spell-for-each-object-it-cou.note: Agrus Kos, Feather, Glimmervoid Basin, Ink-Treader Nephilim, Mirrorwing Dragon, Precursor Golem.
a-copy-of-a-spell-for-each-object-it-cou.partial: Glimmervoid Basin's 'spell, card not on the battlefield, and/or player' also needs change_a_target_to over any Target.

a-cost-at-resolution-filtered-by-who-is-.how: Reservoir Kraken: for each opponent g.may_pay(p, .., Cost::tap_untapped(1, creature), ..): tap_untapped picks among the payer's own.

a-cost-reading-the-card-it-is-paid-for.how: Engine: a cost paid in place of a card's mana cost that reads that card ('pay {X} where X is its mana value', 'waterbend {X}' for the card cast this way) has no form: PlayGrant::instead is a fixed Option<ManaCost> (object.rs:1618) and InsteadOfManaCost has only fixed variants (card.rs:2065); SpellAlternative::cost is an InsteadOfManaCost too (card.rs:2110). Needs a cost read from the card as it is cast (a fn(&dyn Query, &Asker, ObjectId) -> ManaCost).
a-cost-reading-the-card-it-is-paid-for.note: Hama, the Bloodbender; Kentaro, the Smiling Cat.

a-cost-s-filter-reading-the-x-announced.how: Cost filters run with the Cx query, whose announced_x() is None (only Given implements it), and VariableCost has no 'mana value X' form, so a discard/exile/sacrifice of a card with mana value X (the Shoals' alternative cost, Knollspine Invocation, Kozilek, Nahiri's Sacrifice, Scrap Welder, Sidisi, Osgir, Fabrication Foundry, Arcanis, Bosh) cannot read X. Needs a cost-selection X in cantrip-rules.

a-count-of-modes-a-spell-or-an-activated.how: ModalDef::COUNTED is a triggered ability's count only: a spell or an activated ability can't be given it, and an activated one panics (ability.rs:358). Doomsday Confluence's "Choose X. You may choose the same mode more than once" needs a spell's mode count read from its X.

a-delayed-ability-at-each-step-for-as-lo.how: Give DelayedWhen::EachStep an end: a delayed ability at each step that lasts only while its members (or one of them) stay in exile, dropped by step_began once none is (or checked as it triggers, an intervening if over its members, CR 603.4). Today EachStep is never used up and is pushed with no check, so Dimensional Breach's and Ertai's Meddling's abilities would go on triggering every upkeep for the rest of the game after the cards left exile.
a-delayed-ability-at-each-step-for-as-lo.note: Dimensional Breach, Ertai's Meddling. The rest of both cards generates; the body can test the members at resolution, but the trigger itself would still be put on the stack.

a-delayed-ability-made-by-a-delayed-abil.how: The data nests 'When the targeted creature leaves the battlefield this turn, sacrifice this artifact' inside the first CreateTriggerUntil's ActionList, as though the damage made it. Oracle has two sentences of the activated ability: they are siblings. Read so, both are delayed abilities of one resolution.

a-gift-that-changes-how-many-a-spell-tar.how: A min fixed at 0 makes a mandatory target 'up to', a deviation. Only Dewdrop Cure holds.
a-gift-that-changes-how-many-a-spell-tar.partial: Minimum stays 0: "instead two target" is up to two. No if_kicked analogue.

a-hand-played-revealed.note: PlayRule has no such variant; revealing is a one-time g.reveal.

a-keyword-s-cost-changed.note: Warbringer, Memory Crystal: Costed::Spell(id) doesn't say which way or optional cost was chosen, and buyback has no field.

a-land-played-by-what-it-is-as-a-spell.how: Generator writes it (lane g6); landed and checked in Cantrip 01aba4b15: "Play lands and cast spells" is Either[Land-or-Any] read as anything, so no spell test is put on the land (Brilliant Ultimatum; Hauken's Insight's play part too, which still holds on player-rule-special-action).

a-land-type-chosen-second.how: Illusionary Terrain chooses two land types in order (a-choice-of-several-values, a Cantrip gap); the second is that choice's.

a-lasting-block-rule-reading-what-its-ab.how: Cantrip must carry a value on a lasting block restriction: EffectKind::BlockRestriction { card, index } holds no chosen color or player, and the LastingBlockRule it names is a plain fn(q, affected, blocker, attacker) asked by turn.rs with only those, so Skrelv's and Sungold Sentinel's chosen color and The Black Gate's chosen creature (and Raging River's piles) have nowhere to live. Needs a value on the effect (as EffectKind::HexproofFrom carries one) passed to the rule.
a-lasting-block-rule-reading-what-its-ab.note: Skrelv, Sungold Sentinel, The Black Gate, Raging River (which also holds pile forms).
a-lasting-block-rule-reading-what-its-ab.partial: The hexproof-from-chosen half of Skrelv and Sungold Sentinel now generates.

a-lasting-permission-to-cast-from-the-to.how: Cantrip has no lasting permission to cast whatever card is on top of a graveyard: a lasting rule for a player and a zone position, 'the top card of your graveyard' with a type test (instant or sorcery), and the exile-instead of a card cast this way (Bösium Strip). Add an EffectKind (or Playable) for the top card of a player's graveyard with a filter, or let PlayFromGraveyard take a filter and the top card only.
a-lasting-permission-to-cast-from-the-to.note: Bösium Strip. PlayFromGraveyard lets its holder play every card of their graveyard; allow_play is for one object, so a card that becomes the top card later is not reached.

a-lasting-permission-to-play-from-the-to.how: "Until end of turn, you may play cards from the top of your library" from a resolving ability (Gwenom, The Belligerent). PlayRule::LibraryTop is a static ability's only, and allow_play takes one object, not the card on top as it changes; EffectKind::PlayFromGraveyard is the graveyard's lasting rule and nothing is the library's. The same EffectKind for a PlayRule for a duration covers it (with Gwenom's life_for_mana_value grant).
a-lasting-permission-to-play-from-the-to.note: Lane g14: split from player-reference-affected, the library sibling of a-lasting-permission-to-cast-from-the-top-of-a-graveyard.

a-lasting-rule-to-look-at-the-top-card-o.how: "Until end of turn, you may look at the top card of your library any time" from a resolving ability (Gwenom, The Belligerent). PlayRule::LookAtLibraryTop is only a static ability's CardDef::play_rules; no EffectKind gives a player a play rule for a duration, and allow_look is for one object, not whatever card is on top as it changes. Add an EffectKind (say PlayerPlayRule(PlayRule)) that add_player_effect can put on a player for a Duration, read where play_rules are.

a-library-s-top-card-open-to-view.note: PlayRule::LookAtLibraryTop is its own controller's look. Nothing shows a top card to all players.

a-limit-on-the-x-announced.how: cast_only_if runs before X is announced, spell_rules come only from battlefield permanents, and no X cap exists: Open the Way, Spoils of War, Winter's Chill. flash_if is judged before X is announced too (actions.rs:5756): Silver Scrutiny. Soul Immolation landed as Blight X's own limit.

a-limit-on-what-untaps-in-an-untap-step.note: turn.rs untaps every permanent not barred; untap_bans and may_not_untap are per permanent, and no count or choice of which.

a-limit-shared-by-the-abilities-of-one-s.how: Landed by lane g13: 'you may ... Do this only once each turn' is a thing done, not a triggering (603.2h), and the sentence's two abilities (Glava, Five-Advents Mage: a spell cast or an ability activated) spend one key, as hand-written Ancient Cornucopia does with history().done / note_done. Glava holds on operation-set-x.

a-mana-ability-test-that-lost-its-negati.how: The audit said AbilityActivated leaves mana abilities out; it includes them, so a test against OnStack(Mana) is needed, and the printed 'isn't a mana ability' is what restores it.
a-mana-ability-test-that-lost-its-negati.note: Tracker row is a data bug: the generator should honor the negation.

a-mana-cost-paid-for-one-creature-and-a-.how: Tariff: each player chooses the creature (among ties for greatest mana value), then pays that creature's mana cost or sacrifices it. The data pays the mana cost of any tied creature (PayCost ObjectAction PayManaCost over the ties) and then has a separate Sacrifice choose among the ties again, so the creature paid for and the one sacrificed are not one choice. Old: PlayerLoop(apnap){ PayCost { cost: ObjectAction { objects: creatures with greatest MV, action: PayManaCost }, optional } } then unless paid Sacrifice { objects: creatures with greatest MV, choose: AsManyAsCan(1) }. Proposed: per player ChooseObjects { objects: creatures they control with greatest MV, count: Exactly(1) } -> r; PayCost { cost: ManaCostOf(Result r), optional }; unless paid Sacrifice(Selected r), all sacrifices together. Cantrip has it: may_pay with Cost::mana(g.mana_cost(o)) and sacrifice_each.
a-mana-cost-paid-for-one-creature-and-a-.note: Split from cost-part-object-action (whose other cards hold on other holes).

a-mandatory-cost-the-card-s-if-you-don-t.how: Ravenous Vampire: "you may sacrifice a nonartifact creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. If you don't, tap this creature" is If(CostWasPaid, [MustCost(PutCounters(..)), Unless(CostWasPaid, [TapPermanent(ThisPermanent)])]), so it never taps. Proposed: [MayCost(SacrificeAPermanent(..)), If(CostWasPaid, [PutCounters(..)]), Unless(CostWasPaid, [TapPermanent(ThisPermanent)])].

a-maximum-hand-size-of-other-players.note: PlayRule::MaximumHandSize and EffectKind::MaximumHandSize set the controller's value only; neither names another player or adjusts by an amount.

a-may-the-card-prints-read-as-a-must-in-.how: Expedited Inheritance's data makes the exile mandatory; Oracle says 'its controller may exile that many cards'. Old: PlayerAction(ControllerOfPermanent(Trigger_ThatCreatureOrPlaneswalker), Exile([TheTopNumberCardsOfLibrary(Trigger_ThatMuch)], [])). Proposed: PlayerMayAction(ControllerOfPermanent(Trigger_ThatCreatureOrPlaneswalker), Exile([TheTopNumberCardsOfLibrary(Trigger_ThatMuch)], [])). With it the generator writes the card whole (allow_play with Expiry::EndOfYourNextTurn; checked on a local copy of the line).

a-once-each-turn-that-isn-t-a-limit-on-t.how: Landed in lane g3: a may that chooses first is guarded by Event::Done and spends it when something is chosen (Rinoa, Angel Wing).

a-perpetual-change-as-it-enters.how: 'Perpetually' is Alchemy (digital only): Cantrip has no perpetual effect anywhere (see engine-no-double-team).

a-pile-s-name-kept-on-its-objects-for-a-.how: Raging River: each defending player divides creatures into a "left" and a "right" pile, each attacker is given one of the names, and a block rule lasting the combat reads both. Separating (choose::separate) and choosing a name (choose::one_of) exist inside the resolution, but nothing keeps a name on an object for a lasting effect to read: a resolving ability can link exiled cards and remember a chosen name only. Add a per-object note (object, word) an effect's source keeps, read by a LastingBlockRule.
a-pile-s-name-kept-on-its-objects-for-a-.note: Lane g14: replaces operation-piles and operation-choose-pile on Raging River; the card also holds a-lasting-block-rule-reading-what-its-ability-chose.

a-resolution-s-choice-read-by-the-trigge.how: Cantrip keeps a value chosen as a permanent entered (Choices) and a remembered name, not a value a resolving ability chose for the delayed or until-end-of-turn trigger it creates to read: a delayed ability is about a Target only. Needs e.g. GameState::remember_chosen(by: Linked, ChosenValue) read through chosen_color/chosen_subtype(by), or a delayed_trigger that carries a chosen value. Leori, Sparktouched Hunter (planeswalker type), Zombie Boa (color).
a-resolution-s-choice-read-by-the-trigge.partial: Zombie Boa alone could be five delayed abilities, one per color, but no hand-written card does that.

a-reveal-from-an-opening-hand.how: Not an opening-hand action. A trigger that functions in the hand: `triggered(EACH_UPKEEP.functions_in(ZoneKinds::of(&[ZoneKind::Hand])), chancellor, "..").only_if(first_turn_of_the_game)`, reading `q.state().turn.number == 1`; `effects::ask_may`, `g.reveal(you, &[me])`, then the effect. Nothing can have been drawn before the first upkeep, so the hand then is the opening hand. Chancellor of the Annex's 'first spell each opponent casts' is a delayed effect from there.
a-reveal-from-an-opening-hand.note: LEAST SURE of the top rows. Plays the same in almost every game, but it is an approximation of the timing; may deserve `gap` with a small addition to `OpeningHandAction`. Forge reveals in a pre-game step.
a-reveal-from-an-opening-hand.partial: `OpeningHandAction` allows only `counter` and `exile_from_hand`, so reveal-and-remember is not in the form meant for it. The reveal comes at the upkeep, not before the game, so opponents mulligan and keep with the same information but lose it as they play out a first-turn response, and the prompt or

a-reveal-whose-sacrifice-the-data-gives-.how: SacrificePermanent(ThisPermanent) sits inside PlayerAction(Ref_TargetPlayer, RevealCardsFromTheTopOfLibraryUntil...), so the revealing opponent sacrifices an artifact they don't control. Oracle's 'sacrifice this artifact' is yours.

a-rule-on-triggering-where-the-card-says.how: Elesh Norn is PermanentsEnteringTheBattlefieldDontCauseAbilitiesToTrigger(And([IsPermanent, ControlledByAPlayer(Opponent)])): it filters the entering permanents, but Oracle filters the abilities (of permanents your opponents control) for any permanent entering. The grammar has only a Permanents arg; proposed a second arg like the AdditionalTime rule: (AnyPermanent, AbilityOfAPermanent(ControlledByAPlayer(Opponent))).
a-rule-on-triggering-where-the-card-says.note: The generator refuses the entering-permanent reading on purpose.

a-sacrifice-history-with-its-player-lost.how: TheNumberOfCardTypesAmongThePermanentsSacrificedThisTurn has no player, where Oracle says 'permanents you've sacrificed this turn'; NumberOfPermanentsSacrificedByPlayerThisTurn(.., You) is the shape with one.

a-spell-costing-colored-mana-more.note: CostDelta.more is generic only; less is a ManaCost. Add colored more. Five Leeches, Derelor, Davriel's offer.

a-spell-or-ability-on-the-stack-read-as-.how: Not landed and not examined card by card this pass, so this verdict is unverified. Audit said: Target::Object(id) with q.state().stack read: find item, read item.object, kind, controller, Target::Ability(serial) for abilities.
a-spell-or-ability-on-the-stack-read-as-.note: Lane g16 did not land it (out of time); the read sits inside other holes of the same card. Emissary of Grudges holds on a secret choice, choose-new-targets-for-an-ability and cost-part-reveal-choice; Radiant Performer on a-copy-of-a-spell-for-each-object-it-could-target.

a-spell-s-target-changed-to-a-permanent-.how: ChangeTheTargetOfSpellToAPermanent(Ref_TargetSpell, Other(ThisPermanent)): Oracle says 'change that spell's target to another creature', and the creature is lost.
a-spell-s-target-changed-to-a-permanent-.partial: With the data right it still needs a change to a chosen creature among the legal ones: no could-target query (see a-spell-s-target-changed-to-a-player).

a-spell-s-target-changed-to-a-player.how: `change_target` changes to any other legal target, with no kind; `change_a_target_to` takes an ObjectId on the battlefield only (ops.rs:2829). 'The new target must be a player' needs a change to a player: `change_a_target_to` over a Target, or change_target with a filter. With no could-target query card code can't offer only the legal players.

a-spell-s-target-count-of-an-additional-.how: Primitive Justice: "For each additional {1}{R} you paid, destroy another target artifact. For each additional {1}{G} you paid, ...": two slots, each counted by how many times one part of the additional cost was paid. A spell's slot bound is only TargetSpec::COUNTED (its X, or else the times it was kicked), one number for every slot; no count function for a spell's slot exists (only TriggeredDef::counted_by). Also waits on cost-part-mana-any-number-of-times (unsure lane) and numeric-expression-additional-cost-paid (gap).

a-spell-s-target-count-of-times-kicked-b.how: Comet Storm ("choose any target, then choose another target for each time this spell was kicked", 1 + kicked) and Strength of the Tajuru (kicked targets) both have an {X}: a spell's slot bound can only be TargetSpec::COUNTED, which is the spell's X, or else the times it was kicked, never both and never a sum; only a triggered ability has counted_by. Cantrip needs a count function for a spell's slot (as TriggeredDef::counted_by, card.rs:1662), or a second counted value for kicks. Both cards also wait on engine-x-in-a-mana-cost-beside-a-kicker.

a-target-count-read-from-another-target.how: within_together and together_legal judge a slot's together rule with no earlier slot's targets, so 'up to N, where N is that opponent's ...' (Reap) has no read.

a-target-from-a-graveyard-where-the-card.how: From the Catacombs is TargetGraveyardCard(And([IsCardtype(Creature), InAPlayersGraveyard(SinglePlayer(You))])) and Restless Cottage UptoOneTargetGraveyardCard(InAPlayersGraveyard(SinglePlayer(You))); Oracle says "from a graveyard". a-target-the-source-doesn-t-limit-to-you.how: The data's target is TargetPermanent(And([IsNonCardtype(Creature), IsCardtype(Land)])) where Oracle says 'target noncreature land you control': ControlledByAPlayer(SinglePlayer(You)) is missing.

a-text-change-s-duration-given-to-one-of.how: Whim of Volrath, Trait Doctoring, Crystal Spray: "change the text ... by replacing all instances of one color word with another or one basic land type with another until end of turn" gives the color-word option CreatePermanentLayerEffect with no duration. Proposed: CreatePermanentLayerEffectUntil(.., UntilEndOfTurn) for both options (Crystal Spray's DrawACard after both, not inside the first).

a-token-copy-attached-as-it-enters.how: `create_token_attached` takes a CardId, not Copiable values, and the copy calls attach nothing. a-value-chosen-as-an-activation-cost-rea.how: Phyrexian Splicer chooses flying, first strike, trample or shadow as its cost, and its targets read the choice (CR 601.2b-c, 602.2b). StackItem::choice is announced only for a behold type; an activated ability has no announced non-mode choice for its target filters. Needs an announced value on StackItem (or a cost choice made before targets) readable by target fns.

a-value-chosen-in-secret.how: Every `Game::ask` answer and every chosen_* value is public state; nothing keeps a choice from the other players until it is revealed. Needs a hidden answer: a secret flag on the request and a kept value only its chooser sees until a reveal.

A local Copiable replaces TokenSpec: X/X tokens are sized at creation, chosen color/type go through colored/with_subtype, read from chosen_color and chosen_subtype. alternate-spell-cost-rule.how: InsteadOfManaCost is WithoutPaying, Mana(fixed ManaCost) or Energy only. Conspiracy Unraveler needs a Cost there (collect evidence 10); Dream Halls needs a discard whose filter reads the spell being cast ('a card that shares a color with that spell'); Kentaro needs {X} where X is the spell's mana value. Add InsteadOfManaCost::Cost(Cost) with cost filters that see the spell, and a mana cost sized by the spell's mana value.

amount-of-an-event-its-trigger-does-not-.how: No card holds on it. When the trigger's own event is a gap ('trigger event ...', 'engine: no event for dice rolled together'), an amount read of it is FOLLOWS_GAP behind that gap: "Lifetime" Pass Holder, All Will Be One, Curator of Sun's Creation, The Millennium Calendar, The Temporal Anchor, Tyvar the Bellicose, Vexing Puzzlebox. 'That many' of a batch kept by its defender, or of the members a spell-targeting trigger keeps, counts the batch's members: Struggle for Project Purity reads q.event_objects(item).len(). An amount read in a target filter or a target count goes to event-value-in-a-target-filter-beyond-its-subject (gap, g5): Case of the Market Melee, Soundwave, The Wise Mothman. Arcee goes to the-members-a-trigger-keeps-read-through-its-source.

The put that follows becomes g.put_onto_battlefield_with_aura(card, controller, asker.source), and the attach after it is dropped, since the creature enters already attached (CR 303.4f). The failing one counts Delayed.Count = 1 at the end step, and the generated card makes its 'when this enchantment leaves the battlefield' a delayed trigger. Neither exile has a duration, but the Oracle says until this leaves the battlefield. Proposed: the same choice with Exile([...], [Limited(UntilPermanentLeavesBattlefield(ThisPermanent))]) on each arm, as the hand-written card's choose::cards_from and exile_with do.

as-enters-replacement-of-another-event.how: Landed (lane g15): Primeval Spawn's 'if this creature would enter and it wasn't cast or no mana was spent to cast it, exile it instead' asks only of its cast. As it would enter, Entering::object is still the spell on the stack, so cast_of finds its Cast record (none if it wasn't cast) and mana_spent_to_cast reads the mana; entering.instead sends it to exile.

auction-of-the-exiled-cards-until-each-i.how: New module in cantrip-mechanics, e.g. cantrip_mechanics::auction::until_each_chosen(g, source, cards, starting_with, tapped): starting with you, each player in turn chooses one of the cards not yet chosen and puts it onto the battlefield under their control (put_all_onto_battlefield_as with that row); a chosen card that can't enter stays exiled but counts as chosen, and the process ends when every card was chosen (Thieves' Auction rulings). The AST's Repeatable re-checks "cards exiled this way remain", which never ends when one can't enter.

condition-same-team.how: 'Your team' in a game with no teams is you: a filter reads `q.obj(id).controller == asker.controller`, and 'each player on your team' is `[you]`.
condition-same-team.note: A team-free wording; `same_team` is only needed if 2HG comes.
condition-same-team.partial: Real Two-Headed Giant is not played: there is no team, and these 16 are Battlebond-style cards.

condition-searched.how: The search the condition reads is itself held ('operation Search', 'search with several find clauses'). search_zone_and_or_library searches one other zone along with the library, while these cards search two (graveyard and hand).
condition-searched.partial: Takes one zone; three-zone cards combine calls.

condition-subset-meets.how: Each is a plain fn: `fn all_share_a_color(q) -> bool` (an `and` of `ColorSet`s over `q.state().battlefield()`); Dead Ringers: `chars(a).colors == chars(b).colors`; subset-sums walked by plain iteration.
condition-subset-meets.note: A target restriction across several slots needs a slot filter reading earlier chosen targets from `Asker`; not checked in every card.

condition-targets-match.partial: The read of targets exists (stack item), but both cards use it for flash, and flash_if is judged "only as the casting begins", before targets are chosen. Timely Ward also needs commander.

condition-value-chosen.how: Landed: a color and creature type chosen as it entered are read with chosen_color / chosen_subtype of its link (Sarpadian Empires, Vol. VII).

condition-value-chosen-is.how: Shinryu's 'the chosen player' was chosen by its as-transforms ability, which is itself a hole (ability-as-event). The read now follows that hole, and Shinryu's trigger is held by 'engine: no ability triggers on losing the game'. A permanent's own enters choice of a player is read at lane_p.rs:1761.
condition-value-chosen-is.note: No card holds the form now.

condition-voted.how: Travel Through Caradhras: "for each player who voted X" reads the per-player votes of a word vote, a new function in cantrip-mechanics vote module (operation-vote).

condition-voted-as.how: Reads the vote a player cast in the vote that triggered it (trigger-event-player-finish-voting, a Cantrip gap: no vote event).

condition-voted-for.how: Archangel of Strife: what each player chose as it entered (war or peace) has no place on a permanent. A permanent keeps one chosen value, not one for each player.
condition-voted-for.note: `vote` has no options form yet: one shared function (`for_options`) would cover 27+15 cards. That is cantrip-mechanics, no core change.
condition-voted-for.partial: Secret votes ('secretly votes', Círdan, Elrond) are asked in turn, so hidden simultaneity needs the question not to reveal earlier answers: check the answers' visibility. Archangel of Strife's choice outlives the resolution: note each player's pick with `g.note_done(me, AbilityRef::delayed(card, opt

conditional-replacement.how: Landed for "If [condition], this enters with ...": the condition wraps the as-enters body, asked as it would enter, as a static guard is (Dust Animus). Escape with a condition still holds.

conditional-trigger-rule.how: The form lands. Magus Lucea Kane and Repeated Reverberation are a data bug: expires is None though the Oracle text says 'this turn'. Held as 'delayed trigger this turn with no end in the AST'. Repeated Reverberation was whole at the base and is the one card this lane lost.

continuous-change-color-of-mana.how: Landed. In a mana ability, 'it becomes that color' is EffectKind::SetColors(ColorSet::of(chosen)), using the color the activation named.
continuous-change-color-of-mana.note: Foraging Wickermaw: 3/3 scenarios pass as generated.

continuous-change-gain-abilities-of.how: Partly landed: keywords with a plain bit. Hexproof from a quality, landwalk, protection and activated abilities have no resolved way to be copied; AddAbilitiesOf in the held code is invented.
continuous-change-gain-abilities-of.note: The Layer::Ability apply is a plain function.
continuous-change-gain-abilities-of.partial: Resolved form takes one EffectKind::AddAbility per ability, a snapshot rather than a live link (Grell Philosopher, Havengul Lich). Stickers are a gap.

continuous-change-grant-ability-if-absen.how: Landed: EffectKind::AddAbility of the granted ability, added only to each object whose chars.abilities lack that AbilityRef as the effect begins (Musician).

continuous-change-remove-subtype.note: EffectKind::LoseSubtypesOf drops all subtypes of a card type; one subtype has no form.

continuous-change-replace-word.how: Artificial Evolution: the data is ReplaceColorWordVariableWithNewColorWordVariable(TheFirstChosenColorWord, TheSecondChosenColorWord) inside a Targeted_Modal split of spell and permanent, but the card changes creature type words. Proposed: one target spell or permanent with ReplaceCreatureTypeVariableWithNewCreatureTypeVariable(TheFirstChosenCreatureType, TheSecondChosenCreatureType), where only the new type excludes Wall. The hand-written card is artificial_evolution.rs.

continuous-rule-cant-gain-ability.note: No EffectKind; layer writes are unconditional.

continuous-rule-combat-cost.partial: Row 28's card-code covers War Tax and Forbidding Spirit while the permanent stays.

continuous-rule-combat-damage-no-assignm.note: Assignment has no hook to skip a creature.

continuous-rule-combat-group.partial: Same as open-set row: no resolved targeting rule; Crypt Rats banding-like groups none.

continuous-rule-prohibit-attack.note: Chronomantic Escape, Immortal Obligation, Promise of Loyalty, Chaos Dragon: a resolved rule against attacks on one defender: EffectKind::CantAttack is creature-wide. Agyrem: plane.

continuous-rule-prohibit-phase-out.note: Ertai's Familiar, Spatial Binding: no EffectKind stops phasing.

continuous-rule-prohibit-receive-counter.how: Suncleanser's "loses all counters and can't have counters put on it for as long as you control this" is an effect made at resolution: CounterBan is a static of a CardDef only (counter_bans), and no EffectKind bans counters.

continuous-rule-prohibit-regenerate.note: "Can't be regenerated this turn" as a lasting effect has no EffectKind.
continuous-rule-prohibit-regenerate.partial: destroy_no_regen covers "destroy it, it can't be regenerated" as one instruction.

continuous-rule-require-combat-attack.note: Kardur, Maximum Carnage, The Brothers' War: 'attack a player other than you if able': MustAttack is per creature, no defender exclusion, and open set.

continuous-rule-require-combat-be-blocke.partial: The solver takes attacker-only requirements, so only a source is missing.

continuous-rule-untap-step.note: No EffectKind for it; may_not_untap and untap_bans are statics.
continuous-rule-untap-step.partial: AddKeywords(DoesNotUntap) with a Duration runs, but it is an ability a later loses-all removes, and the UntapBan doc says it is no "has". Group "lands you control don't untap" must also lock its set at resolution (CR 611.2c).

copies-of-each-of-several-abilities-on-t.how: Ulalek, Fused Atrocity: 'then copy all other activated and triggered abilities you control'. copy_ability copies one stack item by serial, and the copier's choice of order has no question over stack items: choose works on ObjectIds, which one source's several abilities share.
copies-of-each-of-several-abilities-on-t.partial: Copying in stack order would be exact but for the order the copies go on the stack.

copy-as-it-enters-for-a-duration.note: Entering.copy has no duration. An Enters fn has g, so g.become_copy(entering.object,..,Duration::EndOfTurn) might work: check that an effect added before entry survives the move into the battlefield.

copy-exception-add-ability.how: Not landed: all seven hold on granted-static or engine holes.
copy-exception-add-ability.note: Lane g14: no card holds it. An added ability is Copiable::with_ability, and a keyword (also a characteristic-defining one, changeling) Copiable::with_keyword, as Omni-Changeling's hand-written enter_as_copy. Landed: Choreographed Sparks, Omni-Changeling (both compile in the Cantrip tree and match the hand-written code). Dollhouse of Horrors, Firion, Mocking Doppelganger, Sakashima hold only on granted-static (and their other holes).

copy-exception-add-ability-if-it-doesnt-.how: Flesh Duplicate's copy gains vanishing 3 if it lacks vanishing: needs a new module vanishing in cantrip-mechanics (engine-no-vanishing-enters); the if-it-doesn't-have test is plain card code.

copy-exception-add-color.partial: colored sets, so read and add.

copy-exception-keep-name.how: Landed (lane g15): 'except its name is still [this]' is Copiable::named with the copier's own copiable name (a copy effect's, or its card's). Checked to compile in lane-g2.
copy-exception-keep-name.note: Its only card, Sakashima the Impostor Avatar, is a Vanguard (not played).

copy-exception-set-artifact-types.how: "Except it's a Vehicle artifact" sets the artifact subtypes alone: Copiable::typed replaces types and all subtypes, with_subtype only adds; there is no call that sets one type's subtypes.

copy-exception-set-cardtypes.how: typed_as does not exist, and typed replaces subtypes too. 205.1a keeps subtypes correlated with a type still held (a 1/1 enchantment creature stays a Rat), and Cantrip has no artifact or enchantment subtype set to keep them by. Fear of Ridicule, Machine God's Effigy, Myrkul stay holes.

counter-kind-acorn.how: None today: `add_counters`, `Entering.counters`, `remove_counters` and `Cost` all take a `CounterKind`, so a card cannot name a kind the enum lacks. Once listed, a card spells it as hand-written Wishclaw Talisman does: `entering.counters[CounterKind::Wish as usize] += 3`, `remove_counters(CounterKind::Wish, 1)` in a cost, `g.add_counters(id, CounterKind::Wish, 1)` in an effect.
counter-kind-acorn.note: Mechanical, not a design gap: one line each in `counter_kinds!` (index, variant, name), all 173 in one commit; commit 351845f4e added Bounty with one line in vocab.rs. CounterKind::ALL drives proliferate, 'remove all counters', host views and the client, and dotnet/src/Cantrip.Core/CounterNames.cs s
counter-kind-acorn.partial: None for those that exist once added. A card that writes a look-alike kind (Charge for a storage counter) plays differently under proliferate, Vampire Hexmage-style removal, 'storage counter' readers and the client's pill, so that is not a form.

counter-kind-corruption.note: Mechanical, not a design gap: one line each in `counter_kinds!` (index, variant, name), all 173 in one commit; commit 351845f4e added Bounty with one line in vocab.rs. CounterKind::ALL drives proliferate, 'remove all counters', host views and the client, and dotnet/src/Cantrip.Core/CounterNames.cs s
counter-kind-corruption.partial: None for those that exist once added. A card that writes a look-alike kind (Charge for a storage counter) plays differently under proliferate, Vampire Hexmage-style removal, 'storage counter' readers and the client's pill, so that is not a form.

counter-kind-impostor.note: Mechanical, not a design gap: one line each in `counter_kinds!` (index, variant, name), all 173 in one commit; commit 351845f4e added Bounty with one line in vocab.rs. CounterKind::ALL drives proliferate, 'remove all counters', host views and the client, and dotnet/src/Cantrip.Core/CounterNames.cs s
counter-kind-impostor.partial: None for those that exist once added. A card that writes a look-alike kind (Charge for a storage counter) plays differently under proliferate, Vampire Hexmage-style removal, 'storage counter' readers and the client's pill, so that is not a form.

counter-kind-ritual.note: Mechanical, not a design gap: one line each in `counter_kinds!` (index, variant, name), all 173 in one commit; commit 351845f4e added Bounty with one line in vocab.rs. CounterKind::ALL drives proliferate, 'remove all counters', host views and the client, and dotnet/src/Cantrip.Core/CounterNames.cs s
counter-kind-ritual.partial: None for those that exist once added. A card that writes a look-alike kind (Charge for a storage counter) plays differently under proliferate, Vampire Hexmage-style removal, 'storage counter' readers and the client's pill, so that is not a form.

counters-a-player-has-by-kind.how: Generator writes it (lane g6); landed and checked in Cantrip 01aba4b15: Animation Module: a player's poison, energy or experience counter chosen by a card label, then given one more.

counters-of-a-kind-chosen-as-the-effect-.how: remove_counters_up_to is 'any number' only. 'Remove X counters' is mandatory: choose_counter_kind and remove_counters once per counter.

counters-put-as-a-cost-on-another-object.how: Landed. 'Ward—Get N poison counters' (a ward cost that puts poison counters on the ability's controller) is cantrip_mechanics::triggers::ward_poison::<N>.
counters-put-as-a-cost-on-another-object.note: The Serpent Society: 8/8 scenarios pass as generated.

counters-removed-from-an-object-which-th.how: The history has no event for counters removed (event.rs has CountersPut, nothing for a removal), so 'that a counter has not been removed from with this artifact' (Cyclopean Tomb) can't be asked. Needs Event::CountersRemoved { object, kind, amount } recorded where counters come off, with the resolving ability as Record.cause.

counters-the-event-put.how: Cantrip has to give a once-per-batch trigger every event in its batch, with the kind and amount of each, and let the ability read them when it resolves. Then 'put that many of each of those kinds of counters' becomes a read of the batch.
counters-the-event-put.note: Event::CountersPut carries one kind per event. A once-per-batch trigger keeps the first trigger's data and only the objects in the batch, and Fired::data is [u32; 2], so the kinds and amounts of the other events are lost. Bold Plagiarist, Captain Marvel and Aragorn all need this; none of them can land without it.

craft-materials-that-must-have-something.how: `craft::materials` checks each card on its own; a filter for two that share a type is pairwise.
craft-materials-that-must-have-something.note: Need to read how `Materials` selects, and whether the choice can be validated together.

cumulative-upkeep-paid-other-than-in-man.how: The card's own Effect at upkeep: add the age counter, then loop or g.may_pay(Cost::..) for each age: hybrid symbols one payment each; draw, flip, discard, control as plain calls: cumulative_upkeep::ability(pay, text) takes an Effect.
cumulative-upkeep-paid-other-than-in-man.note: Check against row 87 for the paid events.
cumulative-upkeep-paid-other-than-in-man.partial: Several separate may_pay questions instead of one payment: partial payment is impossible by CR 118.8; refund not possible.

damage-prevented-by-an-effect-of-this-ab.how: Prevented::total is told to then, and nothing stores it for a later delayed ability.
damage-prevented-by-an-effect-of-this-ab.note: PreventionDef has no then, so nothing reports the amount to a delayed ability; see feature 1.

damage-prevented-by-what-the-effect-asks.how: Cantrip has to let a replacement or prevention effect ask its controller to pay a cost while the damage is being dealt (CR 615), and prevent the damage only if they pay.
damage-prevented-by-what-the-effect-asks.note: New form, split from event-change-in-the-program-of-another-event for Heroism ('unless that creature's controller pays {2}{R}'). ReplacementApply and GrantedApply are pure functions, and the only choice an optional replacement can make is a yes/no Question, so no payment can be asked for.

damage-prevented-to-its-targets-read-in-.how: Redeem: "Prevent all damage that would be dealt this turn to up to two target creatures" is CreatePreventDamageUntil(DamageWouldBeDealtByAPermanent(Ref_TargetPermanents), ..), damage by them. Proposed: DamageWouldBeDealtToARecipient(APermanent(Ref_TargetPermanents)).

damage-source-kind-spell.how: Landed: a source that is a spell is an object on the stack, its row keeping that zone once it has left (CR 400.7): `q.state().obj(source).zone.is(ZoneKind::Stack)`. Aegar, the Freezing Flame and Suffocation.

damage-to-each-permanent-a-card-type-los.how: Arcbond's "each other creature and each player" is MultipleRecipients([EachPermanent(Other(Ref_TargetPermanent)), EachPlayer(AnyPlayer)]): the creature type is lost. Proposed: EachPermanent(And([IsCardtype(Creature), Other(Ref_TargetPermanent)])).

delayed-ability-about-objects-and-a-play.how: Landed for Endless Whispers: the delayed ability's subject is the chosen opponent and its source the dying creature, whose `became` is the card in the graveyard; delayed_trigger, not a call taking both a player and objects.
delayed-ability-about-objects-and-a-play.note: Endless Whispers. The generator does this only for a 'when this creature dies' ability whose one list is the card it became; a delayed ability about other objects and a player still needs Game::delayed_trigger_with.

delayed-trigger-at-main-phase-begins.how: Landed. 'At the beginning of your next main phase' is DelayedWhen::Step: that turn's postcombat main from your own precombat main or combat, otherwise your next precombat main. This is what delayed::at_your_next_main_phase does, and a Step delayed trigger keeps its 'about' list.
delayed-trigger-at-main-phase-begins.note: As generated, Mana Drain passes 6/6 scenarios and Mana Sculpt 5/5. Scattering Stroke now holds only 'operation Clash'.

delayed-trigger-starting-players-next-tu.how: DelayedWhen::Step { on_turn_of } fires this turn when made on your own turn before that step; 'your next turn' is not that. at_your_next_main_phase is only for main phases. ExtraTurnStep needs a known turn number, which extra turns make unknown.
delayed-trigger-starting-players-next-tu.partial: A stated other player's next turn takes a matcher.

delayed-trigger-this-turn-with-no-end-in.how: Landed. The data's event is WhenPlayerCastsTheirNextSpellOrActivatesTheirNextAbilityThisTurn: `future_expiry` now gives it EndOfTurn, so it is DelayedWhen::NextThisTurn (Magus Lucea Kane, Repeated Reverberation). Seraph was a false hole: its 'this turn' is the trigger's own, so the check now asks for 'next ... this turn' in one sentence, and Seraph holds on trigger-event-player-loses-control.

destroyed-together-some-that-can-t-be-re.how: `destroy_all` and `destroy_all_no_regen` are each one batch: lands chosen, the land creatures can't be regenerated and the rest can, destroyed at once. Needs one destroy with a per-object no-regeneration set.

discard-of-up-to-a-number-read-as-exactl.note: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Filed upstream.

distinct-planeswalker-types.note: Landed in the generator by lane g7.

distinct-unlocked-door-names.how: Generator writes it (lane g6); landed and checked in Cantrip 01aba4b15: Promising Stairs: distinct cantrip_mechanics::library::object_names among Rooms you control (a Room on the battlefield is named by its unlocked doors).

duration-during-controllers-next-untap-s.how: g.exert is right for a named closed set and landed there. The rest are open sets. A resolving 'doesn't untap' that changes no characteristics or controller modifies rules, CR 611.2c. No EffectKind says it. Keyword::DoesNotUntap is the permanent's own: granting it would end under Humility and count for Muraganda Petroglyphs (card.rs documents UntapBan as never a keyword). EffectKind::CantBecomeUntapped is stronger, it also stops effects that untap and keeps stun counters. untap_bans sit on a battlefield source with its abilities, so a source losing them would end a resolved effect. Needs an EffectKind in Cantrip.
duration-during-controllers-next-untap-s.note: The Duration enum is the wrong place to look: the mechanic is a mark, exerted_by. No hand-written card uses it for this wording yet.
duration-during-controllers-next-untap-s.partial: No event is raised, so 'whenever you exert' does not trigger (right: these cards do not exert). It marks the permanents chosen at resolution only; a text that covers permanents arriving later (CR 611.2c open set) is not covered, nor one with its own controller-relative twist.

duration-during-controllers-next-untap-s.how: Telekinesis's "doesn't untap during its controller's next two untap steps" is on an operation-effect-on Cantrip gap; Duration has no count of untap steps.

duration-during-next-turn.note: The Second Doctor, Willie Lumpkin, Zagorka: a rule on an opponent's attacks that outlasts its source and is per defender. attack_rules are read from the battlefield only; EffectKind::CantAttack is creature-wide, not per defender.

duration-end-of-combat-on-next-turn.note: Brazen Cannonade: Expiry is a closed enum, and a PlayPermission cannot be revoked by a delayed trigger: Game has no such call.
duration-end-of-combat-on-next-turn.partial: Expiry::EndOfYourNextTurn is the nearest form; it runs past combat.

duration-extra-combat.how: Illusionist's Gambit's extra combat needs removing attackers from combat (engine-no-effect-removes-from-combat, a Cantrip gap); Duration has EndOfCombat for the current one only.

duration-extra-turn.note: All in Good Time, Time Bends: schemes (Archenemy).

duration-through-next-turn.note: Sphinx's Decree, Azor, Peace Talks: a resolved ban that lasts into another turn and covers an open set (spells; Peace Talks also all attackers and targeting). Same stop as row 31: CantCastSpellsFrom knows zones only, spell_rules are battlefield only.

duration-until-another-exiled.how: Add an Expiry that ends when another card is exiled with the same link (Expiry::UntilAnotherExiledWith(Linked)), or a way to take a PlayGrant back, so 'you may play that card until you exile another card with this' outlives the permanent as CR 611.2a has it. Expiry is closed (Never, EndOfTurn, EndOfYourNextTurn, UntilYourNextEndStep, WhileControls), PlayCondition is closed, allow_play cannot be revoked, and an ExileCast functions only while the permanent is on the battlefield.

engine-no-champion.note: 'A card champions' is two linked abilities, the link is `linked` (CR 607).

engine-no-choice-between-the-costs-of-an.how: Spells: additional_choice (Bitter Triumph). Activated abilities worded apart: one ability at each price, each with its own words (costs::worded_apart, Transmogrant's Crown); reconfigure at each price lands its two abilities at each (mechanics.rs, Razorfield Ripper). Where the words don't split, a-choice-between-the-costs-of-an-activated-ability (gap). A choice with a reveal among its costs is engine-no-reveal-cost (Dragon's Fire). No generated card holds the form now; Titania is hand-written.
engine-no-choice-between-the-costs-of-an.note: Lane g14: Titania's "Ward—Discard a card or pay {2}" is triggers::ward_discard_or_pay::<2>, as its hand-written file; the generated file is whole, compiles and matches it.
engine-no-choice-between-the-costs-of-an.partial: Two abilities are two abilities, not one, for "activate only once" reads. Cumulative upkeep (Tidal Control) is a cost row.

A `Cast.life_paid` is a one-field fix if it is not readable.

engine-no-effect-adds-colors.partial: SetColors is a snapshot of the colors now, so a later color change under it (an earlier-timestamped effect ending, a changed copy) reads differently from 'in addition'. `granted_static` cannot express it: it is barred from layers 1 to 5. Exact CR behavior needs `EffectKind::AddColors`, a two-line la

Change: `EffectKind::AddSupertypes/RemoveSupertypes`, one branch in layer 4.
engine-no-effect-changes-supertypes.partial: A card's own static ability (Layer::Type, `.own()`) covers 'it's legendary' as long as the source exists; `The Irencrag` was already legendary.

engine-no-effect-draws-the-game.note: Checked: `GameDrawn` is settled only when all players have lost at once; no `Game` call. One small call.

engine-no-effect-sets-power-or-toughness.partial: SetPt's other half is a snapshot, wrong if a later earlier-timestamped set matters; `granted_static` is an ability, so 'loses all abilities' removes it and its value must be computable (fn pointers carry no number). Galion, the listed written card, sets both and needs neither.

Effect: for each opponent `g.create_token_copies_of(g.copiable_values(card), you, 1)`, then `g.add_effect(.., EffectKind::MustAttackAt(Target::Player(opp)), Duration::EndOfTurn)`, `EffectKind::AddKeywords(Keywords::of(&[Keyword::Haste]))`, and one `g.delayed_trigger_about(next end step, .., &tokens)` to sacrifice them, as mobilize does.

engine-no-encore.partial: Araumi of the Dead Tide's 'gains encore' grants it to a card in a graveyard with a cost from its mana cost, which needs a granted activated ability with a computed cost.

engine-no-endure.how: A shared `endure(g, source, n)`: `if choose::one_of(g, you, source, ["counters", "Spirit"])? == 0 { g.add_counters(me, CounterKind::PlusOne, n) } else { let id = g.create_tokens(..)?; }` with the token an N/N: a `CardDef` per N, or the 0/0 token with its counters as printed tokens of varying size are done.

engine-no-endure.partial: An X endure needs a token made at a size read at run time: use one 1/1-sized def and `EffectKind::SetPt(n, n)` from the token's creation, which is a different copiable value from a printed N/N.

engine-no-epic.how: `add_player_effect` for 'can't cast spells this game', and `triggered(YOUR_UPKEEP, ..)` from an emblem with `g.create_emblem` holding it. The copy is `g.copy_spell` of the epic spell.
engine-no-epic.partial: `copy_spell` copies a spell that is on the stack. Epic's copies come when the spell has left: a copy of a spell not there. A per-card re-execution of its effect (`copied` effect) is doable and plays the same but is not a real copy.

engine-no-equip.partial: The planeswalker can be equipped; 'isn't a planeswalker' removal is a layer fn.

The escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus exile N other cards from your graveyard" is granted_ways: escape::granted(cost fn) with escape::cost(printed cost, N), as Underworld Breach's hand-written file. engine-no-exploit-event.note: Colonel Autumn and Skull Skaab watch another creature exploit, which does need an event.

engine-no-fabricate-granted.note: Every card holding it also holds engine-no-fabricate, a mechanics module.

engine-no-fateseal.how: As scry on an opponent's library: `let top = top_of_library(g, opp, n);`, you choose which go to the bottom with `choose::cards(g, you, source, purpose, top, n, true)`, then `g.arrange_library(opp, &kept, &bottom)`.

engine-no-flash-for-an-additional-cost.how: Gap: "You may cast this spell as though it had flash if you pay {2} more to cast it" is an additional cost only for a cast at instant speed; cast_as_though_flash and flash_if give the permission free, and a WayDef is an alternative cost (it won't combine with another, and Omniscience would waive the {2}). Harbinger of the Tides, Mystical Tether, Quantum Reduction, Moonlit Ambusher.
engine-no-flash-for-an-additional-cost.partial: WayDef is an alternative cost by rule: it won't combine with another alternative cost, and it costs a line per card. Quantum Reduction, Moonlit Ambusher unread beyond this.

engine-no-forecast.partial: Revealing is part of the cost in CR 702.57a, but `Cost` has no reveal-self field, so the reveal happens on resolution, not activation. A player can't see the reveal while the ability is on the stack, and a discard in response loses it to no rule. Adding `reveal_self` to `Cost` is a small field.

engine-no-haunt.how: The relation is a link: `g.link_exiled(me_in_exile, Linked::..)` is one form, but the plain form is a trigger that functions in exile. When the haunt card dies (or a haunt spell resolves): `g.exile_with(&[me], ..)` naming the haunted creature, recording with `g.note_done`. The 'haunted creature dies' ability is `when(ZONE_CHANGE, ..).functions_in(ZoneKinds::EXILE)` matching the haunted object from the note, and a filter reads it the same way.
engine-no-haunt.note: Medium confidence. Same one implementation as rows 79, 115.
engine-no-haunt.partial: No hand-written card has a trigger on a card in exile that names a permanent. The note must carry both ids: `Done` has one `source`, so link by the source being the haunting card and reading the creature from the `exile_with` link.

engine-no-vanishing-enters.partial: CR 702.63 has two triggers: removal, and 'when the last is removed', which also fires for counters removed otherwise. `Event` has `CountersPut` but no removal event, so the second is a state trigger, a slightly different timing from a real 'when' on a removal.

engine-no-warp-granted.how: Warp is a way plus the card's own end-step rider (warp::RIDERS, end_step_riders on the warped card's CardDef); a GrantedWay has kind but no rider, so a granted warp would never exile the permanent.

Proposed: EachPlayerAction(AnyPlayer, PutAnyNumberOfCardsFromGraveyardIntoHand(And([IsCreatureTypeVariable(TheCreatureTypeChosenByPlayerThisWay(EachablePlayer)), InAPlayersGraveyard(SinglePlayer(EachablePlayer))]))). exile-cost-an-ability-reads-as-exiled-wi.how: Engine: a card exiled from a graveyard or hand to pay an activated ability's cost is not linked to the ability's source: pay_exiles links nothing (actions.rs:1165), while pay_permanents links exiled permanents for activated abilities (actions.rs:1521). The permanents case landed (lane g13: an activation cost exiling permanents is read as exiled with its source); a permanent spell's own cost (Gorex) moved to the a-card-exiled-to-pay-a-permanent-spell-s-cost gap; Mechtitan Core falls to engine-no-cost-moves-these-objects. mana-symbols-other-than-a-devotion-to-on.how: Count symbols from q.chars(id) mana cost in a plain function (ManaCost fields) and g.add_mana in order; Omnath Locus of All, Incubation Druid read permanents.
mana-symbols-other-than-a-devotion-to-on.note: Costs partition has a row for the query.
mana-symbols-other-than-a-devotion-to-on.partial: Could-produce of other permanents is private (colors_from_sacrifice) for lands with variable mana.

may-enter-face-down.how: Return 'face up or face down': face down is a plain face-down 2/2 turned up for its megamorph cost. `FaceDown` has only Manifested and Cloaked, both turned up for the mana cost of a creature card (intrinsic.rs:252), which Deathmist Raptor's face-down mustn't be. Needs a plain face-down variant; the choice is card code.

mayhem-cost-other-than-mana.how: Not landed and not examined card by card this pass, so this verdict is unverified. Audit said: Green Goblin: the granted form in mayhem.rs.

miracle-cost-other-than-mana.how: Landed. 'Each [quality] card in your hand has miracle. Its miracle cost is equal to its mana cost reduced by {N}' is a GrantedMiracle { text, has, cost: the card's mana cost, less: N } in granted_miracles, as the hand-written Aminatou does.
miracle-cost-other-than-mana.note: Aminatou, Veil Piercer: 8/8 scenarios pass as generated.

mixed-token-text-origins-in-one-creation.how: Holds only where the rules-text token has no color or creature word; guarded.
mixed-token-text-origins-in-one-creation.partial: Treasure takes the text-changing words of the card; it has no color or creature word, so nothing is observable.

mobilize-without-a-fixed-number.how: A card writes its own effect or trigger in place of the const-generic mechanic: `annihilate_x` in Ulamog, `casualty::x` in Ob Nixilis. The number is an ordinary read in the fn.
mobilize-without-a-fixed-number.partial: Arcbound Wanderer is no precedent for this row: it uses `modular::TRIGGER` and counts sunburst on its counters. Ulamog and Ob Nixilis are.

modal-announcement.how: Typhoid Mary chooses modes at random (modes-chosen-at-random, a Cantrip gap).

mode-count-that-is-not-a-constant.how: "Choose up to that many" of a counted reflexive trigger is ModalDef::up_to_that_many(), as Tranquil Frillback: lane_p.rs mode_count_to_come.
mode-count-that-is-not-a-constant.note: Landed in the generator by lane g7.

mode-with-a-requirement.how: Landed. Modes that differ by a requirement ('if you discarded', 'if this spell was cast from ...') become a fn {label}_allowed(q, asker, mode) passed to ModalDef::allowed, and eligible_modes checks it. When an inner choice is flattened into an outer mode, it keeps the outer mode's requirement. The one combination still unsupported is a requirement together with a per-mode history ('unchosen'), which gives gap('mode with a requirement'), and no corpus card hits it.
mode-with-a-requirement.note: No card in the full render holds on it any more. Typhoid Mary, Fractured now writes .allowed(ability_0_allowed) and holds on other forms.

modes-chosen-at-random.how: Effect-time randomness is not choosing modes as the ability goes on the stack (700.2).
modes-chosen-at-random.partial: Modes are not chosen at the stack step; ModesChosen unfired.

modes-chosen-by-another-player.partial: choose_modes asks the controller. One opponent chooses at resolution with one_of when no mode targets (Library of Lat-Nam): card-code, wrong time.

modes-implied-by-the-target-chosen.how: Landed. Modes implied by the target chosen become one union target slot (implied_slots / union_of_modes). At resolution, implied_effect branches on which mode's filter the target passes. Three cases were added: a reflexive ability (delayed.rs), a slot whose filter is the same in every mode (skipped from the union), and an 'other than the subject' read in a filter. Jeskai Revelation is whole and passes its 11 Cantrip scenarios with the generated file swapped in.
modes-implied-by-the-target-chosen.note: No card in the full render holds on it. Etched Slith and Savior of Ollenbock now write the implied slot and hold on other forms.

modes-limited-by-earlier-choices.how: ModalDef.allowed: fn(q,asker,i): walk q.history().all() back; each Record has turn and step, so find your last combat and test Event::ModesChosen.
modes-limited-by-earlier-choices.note: Overturns the tracker: Record.turn and Record.step give the last combat.
modes-limited-by-earlier-choices.partial: Second card unchecked. By Elspeth's Command also needs perpetual effects.

modes-that-may-all-be-declined.note: Shadrix "may choose two" means two or none.
modes-that-may-all-be-declined.partial: ModalDef has min and max: 0..2 lets one mode be chosen; allowed judges a single mode, not the set.

modes-with-a-budget.partial: allowed judges one mode alone, not the chosen set; repeat is a flat count. No weights.

modes-with-distinct-targets.how: mode_masks judges each mode alone, so 'different target for each mode' can't be told.
modes-with-distinct-targets.partial: A filter sees earlier slots, not its own slot's other picks.

modular-without-a-fixed-number.how: A card writes its own effect or trigger in place of the const-generic mechanic: `annihilate_x` in Ulamog, `casualty::x` in Ob Nixilis. The number is an ordinary read in the fn.
modular-without-a-fixed-number.partial: Arcbound Wanderer is no precedent for this row: it uses `modular::TRIGGER` and counts sunburst on its counters. Ulamog and Ob Nixilis are.

move-arrival-flags.how: Lagrella: 'when an exiled card enters under your control this way' has no call for what came back. Mysterious Limousine: returning each other card exiled with it from a replacement. Abstract Performance holds on piles.
move-arrival-flags.partial: `until_leaves` returns the cards itself, so an arrival state on the return needs a hand-written leaves trigger.

move-arrival-state.how: Landed Bronzehide Lion and Summoner's Grimoire's attacking arrival. EntersAs has no tapped (Yue, Vraska, Emergent Sequence: 'enters tapped as something else'); face-down arrivals as a stated thing (Deathmist Raptor, Magar, Missy, Yedora); transformed and attached (Infectious Curse, Radiant Restraints, Strangling Grasp); blocking (Aetherplasm); perpetual (Better Offer). Each holds under its own true name from arrival_hole.
move-arrival-state.note: The tracker's `enter::in_state` lumps several forms; split the row by what is said after the verb and most cards leave it.
move-arrival-state.partial: Not covered: entering blocking (Aetherplasm); face down with stated characteristics (Yedora, Missy, Magar, rows 104/110); colors in EntersAs (rows 92/146); 'perpetually' (Better Offer, digital); a name change as it enters (Princess Yue's 'named Moon', `SetName` exists as an effect after entry). An M

move-arrival-with-a-color.how: EntersAs has no color: Dread Slaver, Ghouls' Night Out, Necromantic Selection, Rise from the Grave, The Master. The audit's 'SetColor in enters' isn't a lasting color: it would end on the wrong timestamp (CR 613.7).

move-cost-exile-from-matching.partial: Night Soil: exiling two cards from one graveyard as a cost; Cost has no rule tying the chosen cards together.

move-cost-exile-from-one.how: Tunnel of Love: a visit ability (ability-visit, a Cantrip gap); The Dominion Bracelet is not played (operation-toward-player).

move-counters-of-kinds-the-mover-chooses.how: g.choose_counter_kind(player, source, from) then g.move_counters per kind in a loop.
move-counters-of-kinds-the-mover-chooses.partial: One question per kind, no totals question.

move-to-ante.note: No Ante zone; casual, and banned everywhere.

move-to-hand.how: Tempest Efreet: ante and exchange (card-outside-ordinary-play, operation-exchange: Cantrip gaps).

multiple-spell-bodies.how: ModalDef.shared: Effect runs after the chosen modes on the item's targets. Tail with its own targets: repeat that slot in every mode's targets.

name-choice-and.note: ChooseName takes looked_at and a kind. Check that a kind restricts it to the revealed nonland names; NameKind was not located.

new-targets-chosen-at-random.how: `choose_at_random` exists, but picking among 'all legal targets' needs them listed: no public query of a stack item's slot candidates (actions.rs:1731 is crate-private), and no call sets a target to a given player or spell. Same missing query as a-copy-of-a-spell-for-each-object-it-could-target.

new-targets-each-player.partial: change_a_target_to takes an object: no stated player target.

numeric-expression-additional-cost-paid.note: Primitive Justice: two repeatable costs, one Kicker field; targets scale with each.

numeric-expression-announced-x.how: No card is left on this form (lane g1, full corpus). Landed: Aurelia's Vindicator (turned-face-up trigger counts obj.x via counted_by, X kept on Object::x by special_action actions.rs:9482), Nissa Steward of Elements (enters hook adds entering.x loyalty), Ancient Brass Dragon. Split onto new forms: removing-x-counters-to-activate-a-mana-ability (Calciform Pools, Crucible of the Spirit Dragon, Dreadship Reef, Fungal Reaches, Haruspex, Kyren Toy, Molten Slagheap, Petalmane Baku, Saltcrusted Steppe); a-cost-s-filter-reading-the-x-announced (the five Shoals, Knollspine Invocation, Kozilek, Nahiri's Sacrifice, Scrap Welder, Sidisi, Osgir, Fabrication Foundry, Arcanis, Bosh); the-x-of-the-ability-that-made-a-replacement-effect (Aladdin's Lamp, Taii Wakeen); the-x-of-the-monstrosity-a-becomes-monstrous-trigger-reads (Death Kiss, Vitality Hunter); a-limit-on-the-x-announced (Silver Scrutiny).
numeric-expression-announced-x.note: Rechecked against Cantrip at 54c3142ee, not the audit: q.announced_x() is a target filter's alone (Given only), so every X outside a spell/activation's own mana, loyalty or RemoveAnyNumberOfCounters cost is a gap.

numeric-expression-any-of.how: `matches!(n, 2 | 3)` or `n == 2 || n == 3`; Lady Octopus compares `history::drawn_this_turn(q, p) < 2` the same way.

numeric-expression-as-of.how: Partly. ThisSpellCast is the card's cast fact (Lethal Exploit, Lifestream's Blessing) and Cast moment reads History::casts in order (Sentinel Tower, Thousand-Year Storm), both proved. TurnBegan (Mindstorm Crown, Power Surge, Sengir) is a gap: no record of the board as the turn began.

numeric-expression-chosen-colors-of.how: Enters fn: choose two colors; entering.chosen_color=first; entering.chosen_number=Some(second as u32). cost_change reads both.
numeric-expression-chosen-colors-of.partial: Encoding by hand: no hand-written card writes chosen_number directly, and anything showing choices shows a raw number. Choices made after entry are not covered.

numeric-expression-chosen-power-toughnes.how: As for operation-choose-power-toughness: labels and a local.

numeric-expression-clamped-damage.how: Landed. The damage dealt this way, but no more than each recipient's life total, a planeswalker's loyalty, or a creature's toughness before the damage, is summed as damage_together returns each amount (clamped_damage_N).
numeric-expression-clamped-damage.note: Drain Life and Soul Burn now hold only 'engine: no rule on the mana spent on a spell' (Soul Burn also 'numeric expression ManaOf'). Without its planned_item, Drain Life's file compiles in the Cantrip tree; its scenarios were not run.

numeric-expression-coin-flips-won.how: Landed: flipping until a flip is lost or the player stops (Fiery Gambit), and called flips with flip_coin (Negative Zone Portal).

numeric-expression-count-mana-symbols.how: A layer-safe count in the card (or one shared helper): fn devotion(view: &dyn LayerQuery, you, colors) sums, over view.state().battlefield() with view.controller(id) == you, cost = cantrip_api::mana_cost_of(&|c| view.cards().get(c), obj, &view.chars(id)), counting symbols[m], twobrid[m], phyrexian[m] of each color, and each hybrid pair once if either half is in the set. Gods: static_ability(Layer::Type, fn affects(view, source, a, _) -> a == source && devotion(..) < N, loses_creature, text). Anax, Daxos, Callaphe, Renata, Tymaret: a CDA of power from the same fn. Chroma: q.card(card).cost over
numeric-expression-count-mana-symbols.note: Nothing is missing from the engine; mana_value_of (game.rs:129) does the same trick for LayerQuery::mana_value. Written as a shared helper it unblocks all 30 at once.
numeric-expression-count-mana-symbols.partial: devotion::devotion and symbols_of take &dyn Query, one color; a layer holds &dyn LayerQuery, and summing two colors counts a {W/B} symbol twice. Both are the helper's to fix, no core change. copiable_values is Query-only: mana_cost_of with chars is the layer's read.

numeric-expression-counters-paid.how: Landed. The loyalty counters removed to activate the ability an event is about are that activation's loyalty cost, read from the ability on the stack by its serial; for a -X it is the X announced (CR 606.4). If the ability has left the stack by the time the intervening if is checked again, the count it triggered on stands (CR 603.4).
numeric-expression-counters-paid.note: Way of the Mind Sculptor: 4/4 scenarios pass as generated.

numeric-expression-dice.how: The dice read are the result of a roll whose keyword action is a mechanics module on every card (keyword-action-roll-die-6-with-an-amount, roll-and-store); g.roll_die returns one Roll (game.rs:881), so the sum of several needs a new function in cantrip-mechanics for the roll first. Clay Golem/Farideh/Vedalken Squirrel-Whacker are held by Cantrip gaps besides.

numeric-expression-die-result-at.how: The Endeavors read "the result of the first/second die": the roll-two-in-order action is a new function in cantrip-mechanics (keyword-action-roll-two-in-order-N) that would return both Rolls in order; g.roll_die gives one (game.rs:881).

numeric-expression-draft-noted.note: Conspiracy draft has no game-state home. 'AbilityOf' is one of three forms grouped here and is a card filter by source; check it alone if it survives.

numeric-expression-earlier.how: Landed: "put onto the battlefield by that player this way" reads that player's own battlefield move (the normalizer now picks the move whose destination is that player's battlefield, Guild Feud), and "that many" after the players' cards were shuffled in together is what each owns of it (The Great Aurora).

numeric-expression-excess-damage.how: Landed: a fight that a later 'excess damage this way' reads marks history().head() and keeps each Event::Damage from either fighter with its recipient_excess, as a damage instruction does (The Last Agni Kai, which holds on player-rule-for-a-while-retain-mana).

numeric-expression-game.note: Yurlok, Pygmy Hippo: losing unspent mana: no event or read (row 69).

numeric-expression-heads-flipped.how: Farrelite: count `Event::AbilityActivated` this turn of `(me, ability)`: `q.history().this_turn().filter(..).count()`. Ral Zarek's coins: `g.flip_coin_for_heads(..)` returns the count.

numeric-expression-noted.how: Nothing in Cantrip keeps a noted value: no note store on GameState, the object row or the history (no 'note' in cantrip-state or cantrip-api), so 'the noted number' has nothing to read. It lands with operation-note's store. Bell Borca alone could be read from the history (greatest mana value among this turn's exiles, history.rs:336), and Sigarda's Splendor's life total from the object's chosen_number (object.rs:1056), but each card also holds on another hole.

numeric-expression-paid-counters-removed.note: 'Remove all [kind] counters' (Catti-brie, Essence Bottle, Geometric Nexus, Hankyu, Jar of Eyeballs, Molten Hydra, Relic Amulet, Sage of Hours, Torture Chamber, Vish Kal): a small addition, or a card-side cap: X must equal the counters. No way for a card to fix X today.
numeric-expression-paid-counters-removed.partial: RemoveAnyNumberOfCounters lets the player choose fewer than all; the rest is right.

numeric-expression-player-number-attract.partial: Number on a player has no store. Chosen number on a permanent exists (chosen_number) if the card is a permanent choosing as it enters.

numeric-expression-player-number-chosen-.partial: Number on a player has no store. Chosen number on a permanent exists (chosen_number) if the card is a permanent choosing as it enters.
