numeric-expression-player-number-ring-te.partial: Number on a player has no store. Chosen number on a permanent exists (chosen_number) if the card is a permanent choosing as it enters.

numeric-expression-player-number-startin.partial: Number on a player has no store. Chosen number on a permanent exists (chosen_number) if the card is a permanent choosing as it enters.

numeric-expression-repeated-costs-unpaid.how: Landed: each player pays with may_pay_times, and what went unpaid is kept per row (Fade Away).

numeric-expression-times-activated-this-.how: Farrelite: count `Event::AbilityActivated` this turn of `(me, ability)`: `q.history().this_turn().filter(..).count()`. Ral Zarek's coins: `g.flip_coin_for_heads(..)` returns the count.

numeric-expression-turns-since-foretold.how: `q.history().all()`, the `Record` whose event moved `card` to exile with the foretell cause: `Record.turn` is the answer.

numeric-expression-votes.how: Needs a new cantrip-mechanics module function in vote.rs, vote::for_words / vote::for_players, that runs a vote for words or players (CR 701.38) and returns the count for each option, as vote::for_permanents (vote.rs:9) does for permanents; most_votes (vote.rs:31) then picks. The count is a local of that tally, which the generator reads once the function exists. Every card also holds on operation-vote.
numeric-expression-votes.note: Unchanged in substance; how reworded so the module verdict is read as one.

numeric-object-property-bushido-value.how: Bushido N has no number on Chars and no module: cantrip-mechanics has no bushido.rs. A new module bushido in cantrip-mechanics with the trigger and fn value(q, id) -> u32 reading the keyword's N from the object's abilities; Takeno reads it. Takeno also holds on engine-no-bushido.

numeric-object-property-color-symbol-cou.how: Landed: the symbols of q.mana_cost(id) that have a color (Omnath, which still holds on its mana forms).

numeric-object-property-crew-count.how: Cantrip records crewing per creature (Event::Crewed { creature, vehicle }, event.rs:151), not per crew activation, and history().crewed (history.rs:472) is all of this turn's creatures: 'crewed by exactly two creatures' (Mighty Servant of Leuk-o) can't be told from a later crewing of the same turn. The card's trigger is a gap for the same reason (trigger-event-object-crewed). Needs one event per crewing carrying its creatures.

object-as-it-was-before-an-instruction-m.how: Landed: the face-down exile leaves its input list behind for "the rest".

object-collection-chosen.how: Landed. 'Of an opponent's choice': the controller picks the opponent with choose::player, and that opponent chooses among the lands the controller controls. The IR fix to SacrificeAPermanentOfAPlayersChoice is in reduce_actions. 'Chooses one ..., then taps the rest' becomes choose::select with Purpose::Keep, and the rest are gathered. Demonic Hordes and Regna's Sanction are whole.

object-collection-damage.note: Comeuppance, Honorable Passage, Judgment of Alexander, Samite Ministration: same as feature 1.

object-collection-earlier.how: Locals; a later ability uses history.
object-collection-earlier.note: Lane g16 did not land it (out of time); the read sits inside other holes of the same card. Meta-Crisis is a phenomenon; Memory Vessel holds on play-permission-lasting-until-next-turn and player-rule-for-a-while-prohibit-play-card; Triple Triad on play-permission-on-an-open-set-of-cards; Indomitable Creativity is hand-written (object-collection-moved-by, per-player-move-under-each-player-s-control).

object-collection-event-group.how: A trigger's condition function has no item, so it can't read the group of an event. Squall is a data bug.

object-collection-from-history.how: Three reads: Backdraft: `q.history().damage_dealt()` filtered by source `q.obj(s).card` sorcery. First Family: walk `q.permanents_of(you)` chars and `q.history().casts()` for `Cast.colors`, `|`-ing `ColorSet`. Herald of Vengeance: `q.history().all()` for last turn, `Event::Damage { recipient, source }`, read names through the object row.
object-collection-from-history.note: Indomitable Creativity is a plain walk over `q.state()`.
object-collection-from-history.partial: A 'last turn' read needs the turn number off `Record.turn`, filtered from `all()`.

object-collection-moved-by.how: Three reads: Backdraft: `q.history().damage_dealt()` filtered by source `q.obj(s).card` sorcery. First Family: walk `q.permanents_of(you)` chars and `q.history().casts()` for `Cast.colors`, `|`-ing `ColorSet`. Herald of Vengeance: `q.history().all()` for last turn, `Event::Damage { recipient, source }`, read names through the object row.
object-collection-moved-by.note: Its only card left, Indomitable Creativity, is hand-written in Cantrip; lane g16 left it.
object-collection-moved-by.partial: A 'last turn' read needs the turn number off `Record.turn`, filtered from `all()`.

object-collection-scoped.how: Spirit of Resilience: "a copy of an artifact or creature card from among those cards" chooses among the cards that left the graveyard, but the data asks for them in a graveyard. Old: ChooseObjects { objects: Zone { scope: Players(zone: Graveyard, players: All), kind: Card, filter: All[Either[CardType Artifact, CardType Creature], InSet(Scoped)] }, count: AsManyAsCan(1) }. Proposed: ChooseObjects { objects: Matching { objects: EventGroup, filter: Either[CardType Artifact, CardType Creature] }, count: AsManyAsCan(1) }, read wherever those cards are now (or as they last were).

object-collection-spliced-onto.note: Minamo's Meddling's question. Need to check for a `Revealed` record at splice.

object-collection-targets-of.how: Landed: the objects the spell's stack item targets, each once (Orvar, which still holds on its discard cause).

object-collection-unpaid.how: Cleansing's reduction asks every player and takes every payment; 'unless any player pays' is first willing, so the ForEachPlayer is read as FirstWilling. Then a list as the audit says.

object-filter-ability-of.note: Conspiracy draft has no game-state home. 'AbilityOf' is one of three forms grouped here and is a card filter by source; check it alone if it survives.

object-filter-alternate-cost-paid.how: ways: &[way(cost(..), ZoneKind::Hand, text)], effect reading item.way == 1.

object-filter-banded-with.how: `q.state().attackers.iter().filter(|a| a.band == band)`; `Attacker.band` is public. A filter for a creature 'in a band' needs a band of two or more.

object-filter-can-target-only.partial: Wall of Shadows: could every target choice: needs a walk of legal specs: not checked.

object-filter-chosen-by.how: Not reached: Grave Sifter now holds on its data form, and is whole with the data fixed.

object-filter-chosen-filter.how: Landed: a card type chosen in the same body (Season of Gathering's 'choose artifact or enchantment') is a CardType local from choose::option, and the filter is chars.is(local). Season of Gathering holds on modes-with-a-budget.

object-filter-chosen-on.how: The audit is wrong. remember_chosen_name replaces the earlier name, so the several names of Day of the Moon can't be stored.

object-filter-could-enchant.how: Cantrip has to make an Aura's enchant quality readable (for example Query::could_enchant(aura, object)) so that a filter can say 'with enchant creature' or 'that could enchant it'.
object-filter-could-enchant.note: CardDef::enchant is a TargetSpec around a filter fn, and host_allows is private to the rules crate. A card can't read another card's enchant restriction, so Rootwater Shaman, Tallowisp and Retether all stay held.

object-filter-could-produce.how: The audit is wrong. `adds` misses abilities whose mana comes from their own effect, and it misses replacement effects (CR 106.7). producible_types is pub(crate), so no card can read what a land could produce (Break the Ice, Obsidian Charmaw).

object-filter-could-produce-mana-of.how: What mana a land could produce (CR 106.7) is cantrip-rules' producible_types, pub(crate) and not on Query or Game, so a card can't ask it of two lands (Mana Web). Needs Query::producible_types(id) -> (ColorSet, bool) exposing it; Mana Web also holds on its trigger (engine).

object-filter-damaged-by.how: Lands for an instant or sorcery whose only ability is the spell and which has one damage instruction: what its object dealt damage to is what it dealt damage to that way (Ghired's Belligerence, and Aurelia's Fury's creatures). Huatli and Demonfire stay held: an ability's source can deal other damage, and Demonfire's Hellbent is another ability.
object-filter-damaged-by.note: Lane g16 did not land it (out of time); the read sits inside other holes of the same card. Huatli, Warrior Poet holds on divided targets and an engine hole (prohibit block on an open set).
object-filter-damaged-by.partial: Players dealt damage this way (Aurelia's Fury) are not permanents: walk `g.history().damage_dealt()` for `Target::Player`.

object-filter-dealt-excess-by.how: Landed with numeric-expression-excess-damage: the fight's own damage records, recipient_excess > 0 for that creature (The Last Agni Kai).

object-filter-draft-noted.note: Conspiracy draft has no game-state home. 'AbilityOf' is one of three forms grouped here and is a card filter by source; check it alone if it survives.

object-filter-exiled-by.how: `q.history().all()` for `Event::ZoneChange` to exile and read `Record.cause`, and `Record.turn`.
object-filter-exiled-by.note: Lane g16 did not land it (out of time); the read sits inside other holes of the same card. Evelyn holds on operation-play-with and player-rule-special-action; Haldan on play-permission-with-mana-as-though-any-color.

object-filter-has-activated-ability.how: Landed: HasAnActivatedAbilityOtherThanThisActivatedAbility reduces to Not(Of(Source)), which every ability of the object fails; it names the asking ability, so the generator counts the object's activated abilities (granted ones included, chars.abilities) past one when the object is asker.source (Tazri, which holds on mana-spending-predicate).

object-filter-has-keyword-family.how: Fields cover toxic, ward, exhaust, the ways, kicker, madness, foretell, suspend, convoke and flashback only. Cascade, Fading, Modular, Unearth, Level up and Cumulative upkeep are identified only by a const or fn, and Disturb, Awaken, Partner, Doctor's companion, Rampage, Soulbond, Blitz, Embalm and Eternalize have no engine field. Without matching ability text, those stay holes. Flashback also needs harmonize and beam me up excluded and grants read (permissions, GrantedWay).
object-filter-has-keyword-family.note: The tracker's `q.has_keyword_ability` would be a convenience, not a capability. Rows with Soulbond, Blitz, Disturb, Rampage etc. need those mechanics first; the query itself is free once the ability's text exists.
object-filter-has-keyword-family.partial: A granted way a permanent gives (Iroh's `GrantedWay { flashback: true }`, escape, mayhem) is on the giver, not the card, so 'has flashback' for a granted one means walking `q.permanents_of(p)` and calling their `granted_ways`. Reading keywords by ability text has no hand-written precedent; a text ch

object-filter-history-attacked-defender.how: Plain function over q.history() and object events in the filter.
object-filter-history-attacked-defender.partial: Scanning q.history().all() reaches the whole game, as Ruric Thar does. object-filter-chosen-filter is Season of Gathering: see modes-with-a-budget.

object-filter-history-counters-put-by.how: Landed: an Event::CountersPut of that kind on the object, put by one of the players (Kid Loki, whose scenarios pass on the generated code).

object-filter-history-counters-put-with.how: Landed: an Event::CountersPut of that kind on it whose Record.cause is an ability of that object (Cyclopean Tomb, which holds on counters-removed and others).

object-filter-history-counters-removed-w.how: The history has no event for counters removed: event.rs has CountersPut but no removal, so 'a land that a mire counter has not been removed from with this artifact' (Cyclopean Tomb) has nothing to read. The generator now holds it on counters-removed-from-an-object-which-the-history-does-not-record. Needs an Event::CountersRemoved { object, kind, amount } recorded by counters::remove.

object-filter-history-cycled-or-discarde.how: Plain function over q.history() and object events in the filter.
object-filter-history-cycled-or-discarde.partial: Scanning q.history().all() reaches the whole game, as Ruric Thar does. object-filter-chosen-filter is Season of Gathering: see modes-with-a-budget.

object-filter-history-dealt-combat-damag.how: Landed: an Event::Damage from the object, combat and more than 0 (Ruric Thar, whose scenarios pass on the generated code).

object-filter-history-enlisted.how: Plain function over q.history() and object events in the filter.
object-filter-history-enlisted.partial: Scanning q.history().all() reaches the whole game, as Ruric Thar does. object-filter-chosen-filter is Season of Gathering: see modes-with-a-budget.

object-filter-history-exiled-from-gravey.how: Landed: a zone change of the card from a graveyard of one of the players to exile (Soovril, which still holds on suspend).

object-filter-history-exploited.how: Exploit has no module (no exploit.rs in cantrip-mechanics) and no event saying what was sacrificed for it, so 'if it exploited a creature' has nothing to read. A new module exploit in cantrip-mechanics that records the sacrifice (a reflexive trigger, as the engine-no-exploit how says) and answers whether it exploited.

object-filter-history-phased-out-with.how: Landed: an Event::PhasedOut of it whose Record.cause is an ability of that object (Ferris Wheel, which holds on visit and its duration).

object-filter-history-surveilled.how: Event::Surveilled { player, count, looked } (event.rs:298) names no card, and a surveil's zone changes carry no reason of their own (ZoneReason has no Surveil, vocab.rs:1426), so 'a land card put into your graveyard by surveil this turn' (Eye of Duskmantle) can't be asked of the history; surveil_into_graveyard (lib.rs:912) returns them only to its own effect. Needs ZoneReason::Surveil or the cards on the event.

object-filter-history-tapped-to-pay-for.how: Plain function over q.history() and object events in the filter.
object-filter-history-tapped-to-pay-for.partial: Scanning q.history().all() reaches the whole game, as Ruric Thar does. object-filter-chosen-filter is Season of Gathering: see modes-with-a-budget.

object-filter-in-pile.how: A pile instruction returns its `Vec`s; every read of them is in the same effect. Bend or Break and Make an Example: all locals.
object-filter-in-pile.partial: Raging River's piles last for combat: mark each creature with an effect until end of turn: writable but with no precedent.

object-filter-in-starting-deck.how: Would be a read of a flag on the object: none exists.
object-filter-in-starting-deck.note: No 'in a deck' flag; Cantrip has no sideboard or wish, so it is true of all cards. Could be vacuously true.

object-filter-kicked-with.how: Landed here with two-costs: reads lane's form, but it needs Compiler::kickers to know which cost is which.
object-filter-kicked-with.partial: A second kicker in `optional_cost` is not a kicker to readers of 'kicked' (Hallar, Bloodstone Goblin): `Kicker` holds one cost. Exact CR for those readers needs `kicker: &[Kicker]`.

object-filter-made-by.how: No TokenCreated event exists: read Event::Entered with Record.cause, and entered_with. Necromancy stays a hole: a generated delayed leaves-trigger and a two-step put-and-attach fail its Delayed.Count and Worldgorger loop scenarios; hand-written uses put_onto_battlefield_with_aura.
object-filter-made-by.note: Rows' two written cards answer it two ways: both ordinary reads.

object-filter-mana-cost-is.how: Landed: the card has a mana cost and q.mana_cost(id) equals the printed one (Urza's Saga, whose scenarios pass on the generated code).

object-filter-mana-spent.how: Landed: 'if another player spent mana to cast it' sums this turn's Event::ManaSpent { player, on, cast: true } of the cast whose player passes (Yume, which holds on player-rule-spells-have-abilities).

object-filter-mana-spent-from.how: Rain of Riches: spent::mana_from_a_treasure_spent_to_cast read by a SPELL_CAST trigger reaching CASCADE.

object-filter-mana-symbol-in-cost.how: Landed: a symbol of the color among the colored, hybrid, monocolored hybrid and Phyrexian symbols, as devotion::symbols_of counts (Namor, whose scenarios pass on the generated code).

object-filter-most-common-creature-type-.how: A fold over library `chars.subtypes` per `Subtype` where `is_creature_type`, count and max.
object-filter-most-common-creature-type-.partial: Digital `seek` is the other half (blocked with conjure).

object-filter-name-first-printed-in.how: Landed. lane_p writes `matches!(chars.name, ...)` over the names first printed in the set (rust_syntax/normalize/src/cantrip/first_printed.rs, generated from Scryfall e:arn/atq/hml not:reprint). Apocalypse Chime and Golgothian Sylex are whole.
object-filter-name-first-printed-in.note: City in a Bottle no longer holds on this form but still holds on others.

object-filter-noted.how: As numeric-expression-noted: no note store in Cantrip to match a noted creature type against (Long List of the Ents, Favored Enemy). An as-enters choice is kept as the object's chosen values (object.rs:1056), but these note one value at a time over the game.

object-filter-nth-cast.how: Elda, Conjurer of Spectacle: a layer filter would have to read the characteristics of an earlier spell. Its granted demonstrate is also unverified.
object-filter-nth-cast.partial: The spell doesn't literally have cascade. Rain of Riches reads treasure mana: row 109.

object-filter-nth-chosen.how: Landed (lane g10): the nth choice of the same body is its local (`Compiler::nth_chosen_local`), tested by kind (`colors.has`, `has_subtype`, `is`) as `chosen.is_some_and(..)` (Vision Charm). Where the choice itself has a hole (Rite of Ruin's ChooseValueWith, Illusionary Terrain's 'a choice of several values'), the read follows that hole's report.

object-filter-on-stack.how: Engine, for the cards left. Earlier cases landed (a filter over StackItems). Peace Talks ('can't be the targets of spells or activated abilities'): TargetingForbid gets &Asker, which tells a spell from an ability but not an activated from a triggered one (card.rs:2435). The Master, Multiplied ('triggered abilities you control can't cause ...'): CauseRule has no ability kind (card.rs:2565). Zabaz ('counters put by an ability of a ... you control'): CounterPlacement has no cause (replace.rs:108). A StackItem's object is the ability's source (object.rs:1048), so none of the three can be read from what these rules get.

object-filter-paired-with.how: Keep the pair as continuous effects, which the state already relates: `g.add_effect(a, b, EffectKind::AddAbility(AbilityRef::delayed(card, 0)), Duration::AsLongAs(card, 0))` and the mirror, the `lasting[0]` condition being 'you control both'. `paired_with(q, id)` reads `q.state().effects.iter().find(|e| e.source == id && matches!(e.kind, EffectKind::AddAbility(_)))`. The soulbond trigger is `THIS_ENTERS` or `when(ZONE_CHANGE, another creature you control enters)`, offered only while both are unpaired.

object-filter-shares-color-with-mana.note: C.A.M.P.: fortify and tapped-for-mana stack trigger: row 21.

object-filter-target-count.how: Landed: the number of targets of the spell's stack item (Wyll's Reversal, which still holds on choosing new targets).

object-filter-targetable-by.how: The audit is wrong. 'Could target' needs the slot's filter under the rules' Given (its X, its subject, the slot's player). The plain Query has announced_x None, and the modal and kicker specs are private (target_specs). Beamsplitter Mage, Exterminator Magmarch and Feather stay held.

object-filter-targeted-by.how: Landed: a stack item whose targets contain the object and that passes the stack filter (AbilityOf reads e.object, the ability's source). Goblin Artisans is whole.

object-filter-was-attached-to.how: Landed by lane g13 for 'Aura cards that were attached to it': an Aura that was attached is a new object in the graveyard (CR 704.5m, 400.7), so it is the card a ZoneChange from the battlefield made of an attachment the host's Unattached records name (event.rs:216, 63). Cass holds on several-objects-arriving-attached. A line counting Auras still on the battlefield (Hateful Eidolon) stays held: data bug, see its earlier note.

object-filter-would-destroy.partial: Equinox: no read of what a spell would do.

object-reference-affected.how: The function's own arguments: CostChange takes (q, source, player, costed, targets).
object-reference-affected.note: Lane g14: no card holds it; each read is now the object it means. Eriette: the data's Trigger_ThatPermanent was lowered as the other object; becoming attached binds the attachment as the event's object (primitives.json5 binds object/permanent/other), so "that Aura" is the subject and its mana value compares right. Space Beleren: a block rule's filter reads the creature asked about (attacker). Teyo: each perpetual change is made for each object. Liberated Livestock: "for each of those tokens" is EachObject, one Aura each (reduce_actions.rs). Feather: an effect on objects is handed the object (`|g, affected|`), inside operation-effect-on's stated code.

object-reference-bound.how: A walk is a `for` loop: the object is its loop variable. Mind Grind: `for p in opponents { let mut lands = 0; .. reveal until ..}`.
object-reference-bound.note: Its only card left, Rottenmouth Viper, is hand-written; the bound read sits under the ways-to-pay-chosen-for-every-time-first gap. Lane g16 left it.

object-reference-earlier.how: Dack Fayden, Helping Hand: the AST lost 'choose a different opponent' and walks independent picks, so two creatures could go to the same opponent. The generator refuses a walk whose line says 'a different' (lane_m.rs earlier_by). With the distinctness in the data, each pick shuts out the rest, as the hand-written card does.

object-reference-granter.how: The card lookup the audit gives is ambiguous with two copies, but needs no fallback: a static grant's stamp is its source's timestamp (layers.rs GEntry), and a resolved grant's is the effect's, so item.acquired names the giver exactly.
object-reference-granter.note: Lane g16 did not land it (out of time); the read sits inside other holes of the same card. Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor holds on play-permission-with-mana-as-though-any-color.
object-reference-granter.partial: The card-based lookup is ambiguous when two copies of the Aura sit on one creature: then the effect's `Acquired.stamp` against `state.effects` picks the right one. An ability still on the stack after the granter left needs last-known handling; a text-changed or copied granter likewise.

object-reference-haunted-by.how: The relation is a link: `g.link_exiled(me_in_exile, Linked::..)` is one form, but the plain form is a trigger that functions in exile. When the haunt card dies (or a haunt spell resolves): `g.exile_with(&[me], ..)` naming the haunted creature, recording with `g.note_done`. The 'haunted creature dies' ability is `when(ZONE_CHANGE, ..).functions_in(ZoneKinds::EXILE)` matching the haunted object from the note, and a filter reads it the same way.

object-reference-made-here.how: `q.obj(me).entered_with`, the ability's link to what the source put in: `Necromancy`'s read of `entered_with` is this; or the `reflexive`/`delayed_trigger_about` holding the object id.

object-reference-nth-chosen.how: Its only card is a phenomenon (Human-Time Lord Meta-Crisis). CardType has no Phenomenon and Cantrip has no planar layout (layout-planar). The second creature each player chose would be a local of that walk once such a card exists.

object-reference-paired-with.how: Keep the pair as continuous effects, which the state already relates: `g.add_effect(a, b, EffectKind::AddAbility(AbilityRef::delayed(card, 0)), Duration::AsLongAs(card, 0))` and the mirror, the `lasting[0]` condition being 'you control both'. `paired_with(q, id)` reads `q.state().effects.iter().find(|e| e.source == id && matches!(e.kind, EffectKind::AddAbility(_)))`. The soulbond trigger is `THIS_ENTERS` or `when(ZONE_CHANGE, another creature you control enters)`, offered only while both are unpaired.

object-reference-ring-bearer.note: No Ring-bearer in state or mechanics.

object-reference-scoped.how: Engine: each read is the object an enclosing rule is asked about, and that rule's Cantrip form takes no such object. Dream Halls and Demon of Fate's Design: the cost paid instead of a spell's mana cost is a fixed InsteadOfManaCost (card.rs:2065, 2110), so 'a card that shares a color with that spell' / 'life equal to its mana value' can't read the spell. Soul Partition: PlayGrant has no rider on the spell cast (object.rs:1618; its `more` is one fixed number). Unpredictable Cyclone: a draw replacement's CardDraw has no cause (replace.rs:152), so 'the cycled card' can't be read. Takklemaggot: a granted trigger can't keep the player chosen as it returned (Choices keeps only as-enters values, object.rs:225).
object-reference-scoped.note: Soul Partition could be written another way: only the owner may play the card, so 'cast by an opponent' is known as the permission is made and `more: 2` could be set then. That is generator work inside play-permission-with-an-effect-on-what-is-played, not this read.

object-reference-sole-target-of.how: q.sole_target does not exist. Read state.targets(item) with left_stack as Leyline of Resonance does. 'Targets only a single' holds however many times it was chosen (115.9c), while OnStack(SingleTarget) counted them: both now told apart by the printed words.

object-reference-source-of.how: Landed in lane g3: the targeted activated ability's source from its stack item, or from left_stack once countered (Interdict, Ouphe Vandals).

object-state-controlled-since-before-com.note: controlled_since is by turn, not step.

object-state-cost-paid-madness.how: Grave Scrabbler: a trigger on Discarded with a cast by madness: read the Cast record's instead? Or an enters test on cast_from == Exile with history of own Discarded.
object-state-cost-paid-madness.partial: No flag read: inferred from cast_from and a discard this turn; not exact for a second cast.

object-state-cost-paid-prowl.how: Prowl has no WayKind and no module (no prowl.rs in cantrip-mechanics; the way's kind is what 'if its prowl cost was paid' reads). A new module prowl in cantrip-mechanics with the way, its combat-damage condition and WayKind::Prowl; then q.state().obj(id).cast_way names it.

object-state-couldnt-attack.note: The declaration keeps no record of who could not attack.

object-state-devoured-a-creature.how: `e.chosen_number = Some(eaten.len() as u32)` in `enters`, read by `choose::chosen_number(q, asker)` in the static or ability.

object-state-embalmed.how: `q.obj(token).entered_with` or `Record.cause` on the token's creation names embalm's ability: `Cause::Ability { source, ability }`, then compare the ability's text. Embalm itself is an activated ability, and 'if this creature was embalmed' reads it from the copy's own `Copiable` exception, written in the same effect.

object-state-foretold.how: `q.history().all().iter().any(|r| matches!(r.event, Event::ZoneChange { object, .. } if object == c) && matches!(r.cause, ..foretell..))`, or `q.card(c).foretell.is_some()` on a face-down card in exile you own.
object-state-foretold.partial: A card with a granted foretell (Ranar, Alrund's Epiphany's cast) needs the special-action record; the plain read misses a card exiled face down otherwise.

object-state-had-to-attack.note: The declaration keeps no record of forced attackers.

object-state-haunted-by-source.how: The relation is a link: `g.link_exiled(me_in_exile, Linked::..)` is one form, but the plain form is a trigger that functions in exile. When the haunt card dies (or a haunt spell resolves): `g.exile_with(&[me], ..)` naming the haunted creature, recording with `g.note_done`. The 'haunted creature dies' ability is `when(ZONE_CHANGE, ..).functions_in(ZoneKinds::EXILE)` matching the haunted object from the note, and a filter reads it the same way.

object-state-most-votes.how: Reads the tally of the vote before it: vote::most_votes over vote::for_permanents's tally (vote.rs:9, 31), as Council's Judgment does, once operation-vote is written. Council Guardian votes for a color, which needs the new module function vote::for_words in cantrip-mechanics. Lands with operation-vote.

object-state-non-basic-land-type.how: `chars.subtypes` holds land types: filter with `!matches!(s, Subtype::Plains | Subtype::Island | Subtype::Swamp | Subtype::Mountain | Subtype::Forest)` and a land type test.

object-state-paired.how: Keep the pair as continuous effects, which the state already relates: `g.add_effect(a, b, EffectKind::AddAbility(AbilityRef::delayed(card, 0)), Duration::AsLongAs(card, 0))` and the mirror, the `lasting[0]` condition being 'you control both'. `paired_with(q, id)` reads `q.state().effects.iter().find(|e| e.source == id && matches!(e.kind, EffectKind::AddAbility(_)))`. The soulbond trigger is `THIS_ENTERS` or `when(ZONE_CHANGE, another creature you control enters)`, offered only while both are unpaired.
object-state-paired.note: Same machinery as row 12: one implementation answers all of rows 12, 13, 14 and 129.

object-state-received-a-vote.how: Trap the Trespassers: a secret council vote for creatures, whose tally per candidate would come from vote::for_permanents (vote.rs:9), but its votes are secret (operation-reveal-choices is a gap: no hidden answer); a new module function in cantrip-mechanics for secret votes is needed beside it.

object-state-renowned.how: As row 23: the `Done` note is the mark, ended by the new object id.

object-state-snow-mana-of-own-color-spen.how: Landed (lane g10): `q.history().mana_spent_to_cast(spell)` filtered to snow sources (`q.chars(source).supertypes.snow`) whose tally holds a color of the spell (`mana.get(c.mana()) > 0`), and the card's `mana_told_apart: &[snow_mana]` so the payer picks which snow mana pays (CR 106.4, 601.2h). Boreal Outrider now holds only on operation ChangeSpell.

object-state-started-turn-untapped.note: No `Untapped` event, and `TurnBegan` is not triggerable.

object-state-tribute-not-paid.how: Tribute: enters: Some(fn(g, entering)) asks g.ask for an opponent (choose::player), asks them yes/no (effects::ask_may), adds entering.counters[PlusOne] += N, and records the refusal; 'if tribute wasn't paid': an intervening if: when(THIS_ENTERS) with .condition reading Obj state. The refusal can be a data word (Obj.chosen) or the absence of a Counters Event: a shared mechanics/tribute.rs of 30 lines.
object-state-tribute-not-paid.partial: Checked only that an enters fn may ask (number_as_enters does). No keyword: reminder text only; a -1/-1-counter-based replacement of the counters still counts as paid, the rule says paid.

object-state-unearthed.how: `Event::Done` from unearth's ability, read by the object's id, or `q.obj(id).cast_way` for the way.
object-state-unearthed.partial: Malfegor Avatar is a Vanguard: blocked by card type whatever the read. Unearth is an activated ability, not a way, so `cast_way` does not apply.

objects-that-paid-a-cost-at-resolution.how: Settled: where the payment's own code has a hole (a cost part, a cost of moving cards; Swift Warkite), what paid it follows that hole's report; discards and blights land as before. No card holds on this form any more.

offering.note: Offering reduces by the sacrificed permanent's whole mana cost, colored symbols too. Emerge reduces by mana value only.
offering.partial: way(Cost{emerge: true, permanents: sacrifice, ..}, Hand).instant_speed() is a generic-only stand-in.

one-or-more-that-die-read-as-each-in-the.how: The data's trigger is WhenAPermanentDies(And([Other(ThisPermanent), And([IsCreatureType(Cat), ControlledByAPlayer(SinglePlayer(You))])])) where Oracle says 'Whenever one or more other Cats you control die' (Ajani; the Bee's and Townsfolk's are other creatures): a batch that triggers once (CR 603.2c), as WhenAnyNumberOfCreaturesOrPlaneswalkersDie(..) reads it. Read as each, two Cats dying together trigger twice.
one-or-more-that-die-read-as-each-in-the.note: Ajani, Nacatl Pariah; Great Fierce Bee; Vengeful Townsfolk.
one-or-more-that-die-read-as-each-in-the.partial: With the data right, the -4 still needs one permanent choosable for several types (cantrip_mechanics::each_opponent_keeps_one_of_each_type), and the trigger asks to exile Ajani when he is gone.

operation-any-player-may-pay.how: Icy Prison: loop over players in turn order, g.may_pay(p, ..); stop at a yes; else sacrifice.

operation-attach-chosen.how: Landed (lane g10): for any host set that is not one object, the attachments are chosen, then the host with `choose::card` (a lone host taken without asking), then `g.attach` (Gilgamesh, Master-at-Arms). Gilgamesh holds on RemainingToBottomAtRandom and a reflexive ability about a list.

operation-attach-each.how: Attach to a player has no call (corrections of the last pass). Archnemesis, Ardenn, Maddening Hex.
operation-attach-each.partial: To a player (Archnemesis, Maddening Hex, The Unluckiest Planeswalker, 3 cards): attach takes ObjectId host, no form.

operation-bid.how: A loop in turn order over choose::number(g, player, source, least, most, ..) until all pass; the winner and amount are locals.
operation-bid.partial: No bid module; a player's life as the top limit is the card's to read.

operation-change-combat.partial: A printed AttackRule covers "only these" as a static.

operation-change-zone.how: Landed for one per card type, total mana value, same names and the like (Atraxa, Hurkyl, Portent of Calamity, Revival Experiment, Moorland Rescuer, Stroke of Luck, Karn Scion, Mangara's Tome, Parallel Thoughts). What is left: Cantrip's FaceDown is Manifested or Cloaked, so 'face down as a 2/2 stated creature' (Cybership, Death in Heaven, The Cyber-Controller, The Moonbase, Tezzeret Cruel Machinist) has no call; these hold as 'put onto the battlefield face down as a stated creature'. Technomancer is a data bug: the source reads ReturnAnyNumberOfGroupCardsMilledThisWayToBattlefield with no group rule of total mana value.
operation-change-zone.partial: One card per type: part with a matching: see target-constraint-one-for-each. A face-down exile pile as one thing (Mangara's Tome): linked exile list, no ordering guarantee.

operation-choose-action.how: labels and one_of; asked of any player.

operation-choose-and-pay.how: players::choose_and_pay does not exist. select any number, then one may_pay of mana.times(n); declining leaves none chosen. Mana costs only.

operation-choose-at-random.how: Landed for every played card: a color at random from those no permanent of theirs has (`g.choose_at_random(pool.len())` over `Color::ALL` less the held colors; Opulent Clomper, which holds on 'engine: no effect adds colors'). The one card left is Master of the Wild Hunt Avatar, a Vanguard card: Cantrip has no Vanguard card type or game, so the card can't be played whatever the generator writes.
operation-choose-at-random.note: Only a not-played card (Vanguard) is left; the form's own code is written.

operation-choose-defender.how: Landed (lane g10): the candidates are the players and planeswalkers that creatures of the attacker player attack (`q.state().attackers`), and `combat::choose_among` picks one (Tahngarth, First Mate, which holds on operation ChangeCombat).

operation-choose-pile.how: Not landed: every card also holds on operation-piles, object-filter-in-pile, operation-move or operation-change-combat. Abstract Performance and Hostile Negotiations need a pile exiled unshuffled and face down that a later pick reads.
operation-choose-pile.note: Lane g14: no card holds it. A choice of piles exiled by an instruction with a hole of its own (Abstract Performance and Hostile Negotiations: operation-move; The Celestial Toymaker: operation-change-zone) follows that hole; the face-down/face-up arm (choose::face_down_or_face_up_pile) writes it once the exile keeps its piles. Raging River's named piles are a-pile-s-name-kept-on-its-objects-for-a-lasting-rule.

operation-choose-power-toughness.how: Label::Option through choose::option and CardDef labels, not a local 'sizes': the words are the printed +1/-1 and -1/+1.

operation-choose-value-with.how: A secret choice has no form (see operation-reveal-choices); it is now its own hole, 'a value chosen in secret'. The other cards hold on their own holes: choices read outside their body, several values, the-other-color mana.
operation-choose-value-with.note: No hand-written "secretly" card exists: confirm hosts do not leak another player's Answer.
operation-choose-value-with.partial: Across turns: secrecy for a value kept on a permanent (Emissary of Grudges, Guardian Archon, Ominous Lockbox): choices are public state: gap. Multiple keywords (Greymond), colors (Desert Cenote) on one permanent: see a-choice-of-several-values. Stickers and Cryptic Spires unplayable.

operation-clash.how: A plain function in cantrip-mechanics: reveal the two tops with g.reveal, compare mana values, ask each to bottom; returns whether the actor won.
operation-clash.note: Needs a new shared module (CR 701.30), not an engine change.
operation-clash.partial: No clash event, so clash triggers (feature 119, 4 cards) stay gaps.

operation-coin-flips.how: Not landed: Fiery Gambit and Negative Zone Portal hold on numeric-expression-coin-flips-won, Karplusan Minotaur on cumulative upkeep.

operation-copy-each.how: Copy with stated target: let c = g.copy_spell(spell, copier, false)?; g.change_a_target_to(Target::Object(c), creature, copier)? (Precursor Golem, Mirrorwing Dragon, Zada). Take: g.change_controller + g.choose_new_targets (Commandeer, Aethersnatch). Retarget: g.change_target, change_a_target_to. Copy each: a loop. "Targets only": read q.state().stack in the trigger's match.
operation-copy-each.partial: change_a_target_to takes an ObjectId: a stated player target has no form (Radiate to players, Zevlor, Grip of Chaos on players). choose_new_targets is spell-only (Boltbender abilities). At random: enumerate by can_target and spec filter.

operation-copy-on-stack.how: Landed copies with new targets chosen and copies gathered per player. Each/EachLegal needs a test of whether a spell on the stack could target an object, and Cantrip has none. Random targets (Chef's Kiss, Grip of Chaos) no call. Rebound, Reflecting Mirror: change_a_target_to takes objects only, not players. Quicksilver Dragon is a data bug.
operation-copy-on-stack.partial: change_a_target_to takes an ObjectId: a stated player target has no form (Radiate to players, Zevlor, Grip of Chaos on players). choose_new_targets is spell-only (Boltbender abilities). At random: enumerate by can_target and spec filter.

operation-counter-with.how: CounterTo has no battlefield (Desertion). Delay's 'it gains suspend' can't be given: suspend is a CardDef field read from the card, no effect adds it.
operation-counter-with.partial: A 'gains suspend' on the exiled card has no form (Delay). Desertion's 'instead of' means the spell never hits a graveyard: a replacement is needed for exactness.

operation-deal-damage.partial: The turn-wide rule is wrong for one instruction.

operation-deal-damage-with.how: Part of a damage prevented by a number just paid has no call (Errant Minion, Power Leak), and Master of the Wild Hunt's damage divided by another player has none.

operation-delayed-unless-paid.note: 'Pay before that step' is an action of a player who may not control the source: no any-player special action, as row 13.
operation-delayed-unless-paid.partial: Stand-in: delayed_trigger at that step with g.may_pay. The Cobra's 'before that step' then pays after untapping, which is a real change.

operation-each-counter-kind.how: `for k in CounterKind::ALL { if q.counters(id, k) > 0 { .. } }`, or the prompt `g.choose_counter_kind(you, source, id)?` to pick among those present.

operation-each-number.how: The one card is Ornate Imitations, an Alchemy card: 'conjure a random creature card with that mana value' needs a card pool to conjure from, and Cantrip has no conjure or card creation outside tokens and copies.
operation-each-number.note: Only a not-played (Alchemy, digital) card is left.

operation-each-player.how: Landed (lane g10): 'each player' inside a walk of those same players is that player's own turn (`lane_i::own_turns`), so the walked player is the acting one, and a reveal's matches are carried out of the walk's if-present block. Mind Grind holds on operation LimitX and per-player ChangeZone.

operation-effect-on.note: The next spell of a kind, and riders on spells as cast: the core comment at object.rs:1415 says a card file cannot mark a spell during casting and that a filter is to be added when a card needs one. Draconic Debut, Elminster, Kaza, Maelstrom Muse, World War Hulk, Soulfire Grand Master, Marshland Blo
operation-effect-on.partial: A LastingCostChange could read history for "first spell since", but it cannot carry an X and no serial of when it began.

operation-exchange.note: Ownership, text boxes, ante and exchanges until a duration: Bronze Tablet, Deadpool and the rest of the row.

operation-game-effect.note: Rest of the row: can't phase in, Camouflage, Chaos Moon, Bad Wolf Bay, schemes. Not settled one by one; low confidence on the count.

operation-give-control.how: Landed by lane g13 for 'gain control ... until end of turn': gain_control takes a Duration (game.rs:1193). Seize the Spotlight holds on per-player-give-control and condition-voted-for.

operation-limit-x.note: x_cant_be_zero is the only rule on X.

operation-meld.how: Melding: two cards as one permanent.
operation-meld.note: Checked: no `meld` on Game, in rules or in Obj; a two-card object needs the representation (zones, leaving as two cards), not a verb. Real engine work.

operation-move.how: Landed. Lane g13: 'exile the top four cards of your library in a face-down pile' is exile_face_down (game.rs:1077) and a face-up pile exile_all (game.rs:712), the pile being what moved; an unshuffled pile's order is no secret. Abstract Performance and Hostile Negotiations hold on operation-choose-pile (and keyword-action-turn-pile-face-up).

operation-move-counters.partial: Ornate Imitations needs a conjure pool.

operation-note.note: Ice Cauldron, Dragonborn Immolator's Gift (a gift condition): the former notes a mana type then spends it on one spell: mana restriction to a named spell is row 20's. Not read past their text.

operation-pay-repeatedly.how: Loop: while player accepts: may_pay or ask then act; a local count. may_pay_times for mana alone.

operation-pick-from-hand.note: Word of Command: controlling a player.

operation-piles.how: Not landed: no card is held by this and nothing else; object-filter-in-pile and per-player-piles are what keep them.

operation-play-with.note: Illusionary Mask (mana lot, face down) and The Fourth Doctor (PlayRule::LibraryTopLands has no filter for 'historic land', and a limit of once).

operation-players-do.how: Infernal Denizen: inside APlayerMayAction "You" is the doer (Stardew Valley's GainControlOfPermanent reads so, and is landed), so "a creature you control" names the opponent. Old: APlayerMayAction(Opponent, GainControlOfAPermanentUntil(And([IsCardtype(Creature), ControlledByAPlayer(SinglePlayer(You))]), UntilPermanentLeavesBattlefield(ThisPermanent))). Proposed: APlayerMayAction(Opponent, GainControlOfAPermanentUntil(And([IsCardtype(Creature), ControlledByAPlayer(SinglePlayer(ControllerOfPermanent(ThisPermanent)))]), UntilPermanentLeavesBattlefield(ThisPermanent))).
operation-players-do.note: Stardew Valley and Protection Racket, also on this form, are landed.

operation-players-pay-repeatedly.how: Landed: g.may_pay_times for each player in turn (Fade Away).

operation-put-counters-each.partial: Ornate Imitations needs a conjure pool.

operation-return-after.how: Generator writes it (lane g16): exile until an opponent becomes the monarch is g.exile_with linked plus one DelayedWhen::UntilEvent delayed trigger per card on EventMask::BECAME_MONARCH, returning it with put_onto_battlefield under its owner; nothing is exiled if an opponent already became the monarch since the source entered (CR 610.3b). Calix and Lumbering Battlement landed earlier (g11).
operation-return-after.note: No cards left. Palace Jailer's generated file compiles in Cantrip 01aba4b15 and passes real_cards until_exile (2 tests) in place of the hand-written one.

operation-reveal-choices.how: Secret choices need Cantrip to hide an answer from other players until revealed; nothing does. Every card also holds on vote or chosen-number holes; Ominous Lockbox's 'secretly choose a number' holds as 'a value chosen in secret', and Nyota Uhura's public number_as_enters would be a rules deviation for it.
operation-reveal-choices.partial: Secrets kept across turns on a permanent: chosen_* are public: gap. Host leak of journalled answers unchecked. No hand-written "secretly" card.

operation-search.how: Landed one search across library and graveyard via search_as_one. Doomsday stays a hole: it needs one ordered choice over two zones, not the search the audit names, and held under 'cards found in two zones put on top of a library'.
operation-search.note: Corrected: Doomsday and Turtles Forever raise the search event from card code.

operation-set-x.note: Checked: X is read at cast; no setter on `Game`. Small.

operation-together.how: Landed (lane g10) beside the earlier ones: choices only run one after another; damage parts that each make a `damage_together` batch go in one batch (CR 120.3); parts with a hole of their own wrap the begin/end in a stand-in that follows those holes. No card holds on this form any more.
operation-together.note: 'Goblin Welder' was marked as blocked by this but ships with `sacrifice_and_return`.

operation-turn-face-down-as.note: Checked: `FaceDown` is Manifested or Cloaked; no stated P/T. Same as rows 74, 110.

operation-vote.how: Ask in APNAP order in a mechanics function, one for words next to vote::for_permanents; the tally is a local value the resolving function reads.
operation-vote.note: A g.votes() store is only needed by a later object; within one resolution a local is enough.
operation-vote.partial: Word, player and graveyard votes are not shared yet, and Secret Council needs hidden answers, which I did not check. Triggers on votes are feature 137.

operation-with-reflexive.how: No event records a regeneration, so 'when it regenerates this way' cannot be heard: Matopi Golem, Soldevi Sentry, Skeleton Scavengers. No form exists for these.
operation-with-reflexive.partial: Excess-damage amounts depend on what g.damage returns; unread.

per-player-add-mana.how: Landed (lane g10): adding mana is walked, one player after another, a pool nothing sees until it is spent (CR 106.4). Yurlok holds on player-rule-as-mana-empties.
per-player-add-mana.note: Tracker misread: the choice falls before the batch, not between. proposed begin_batch is unnecessary.

per-player-change-zone.how: Generator writes it (lane g16): a change of zone in a per-player body whose cards are every player's ("puts all cards revealed this way into their graveyard") is one move of all of them, each to its owner's zone (CR 101.4), with g.move_together (Mind Grind). A move onto the battlefield still walks.
per-player-change-zone.note: No cards left: Mind Grind holds only operation-limit-x; Stronghold Gambit now holds per-player-reveal-choices (gap) instead.
per-player-change-zone.partial: The only limit: a suspension inside instruction. Steps that genuinely ask midway (a sacrifice whose replacement asks) are not one batch. Villainous cards here also need that row.

per-player-choice-among-different-action.how: Engine: 'you and defending player each discard a card or sacrifice a permanent' happens at once for all (CR 101.4), one player discarding while another sacrifices. Cantrip makes one batch of a discard (discard_together, game.rs:616) or of sacrifices (sacrifice_each, game.rs:678), never of both, and has no begin_batch. Needs a batch over different actions, or a call that discards and sacrifices together. Eumidian Wastewaker.

per-player-choice-of-what-to-exile-exile.how: Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God +1: each opponent in APNAP order chooses a card from their hand or a permanent they control (CR 101.4), then all are exiled at once with one g.move_together of (card, Zone::exile(owner)) - no begin_batch/end_batch, which Cantrip does not have.
per-player-choice-of-what-to-exile-exile.note: Lane g16 did not land it (out of time); the read sits inside other holes of the same card. Nicol Bolas is also held by the-loyalty-abilities-of-other-permanents (card-code; grant_loyalty_abilities_of does not exist in cantrip-mechanics).

per-player-choose-pile.how: Landed (lane g10): separating piles and choosing one (with no destination) are choices, walked. Stand or Fall holds on operation Piles, operation ChoosePile, PossibleDefender and ChangeCombat.

per-player-create-tokens.how: Landed for the cards it can make whole. Lane g13 split the last two: Mardu Siegebreaker onto per-player-tapped-token-copies-of-several-objects, Peacekeeper Avatar onto per-player-tokens-entering-attached (both gap).

per-player-discard-all-but.how: Ask every player first into locals in a loop, then one batched call: g.sacrifice_each(&[(player,id)]), g.discard_together, g.move_together, g.put_all_onto_battlefield*, g.create_tokens_together, g.create_token_copies_together, g.create_tokens_attacking; or instruction(g, |g| ...) around question-free steps.
per-player-discard-all-but.note: Tracker misread: the choice falls before the batch, not between. proposed begin_batch is unnecessary.
per-player-discard-all-but.partial: The only limit: a suspension inside instruction. Steps that genuinely ask midway (a sacrifice whose replacement asks) are not one batch. Villainous cards here also need that row.

per-player-each-player.how: Landed with operation-each-player (lane g10, `lane_i::own_turns`). No card holds on this form any more.
per-player-each-player.note: Tracker misread: the choice falls before the batch, not between. proposed begin_batch is unnecessary.

per-player-give-control.how: Seize the Spotlight: for each opponent who chose fame (a walk over them, CR 101.4), the caster chooses a creature that player controls and g.gain_control(source, creature, you, Duration::EndOfTurn), then untaps those creatures and grants haste until end of turn.
per-player-give-control.note: Lane g16 did not land it (out of time); the read sits inside other holes of the same card. Seize the Spotlight is also held by condition-voted-for (gap), which reads which opponents chose fame; this walk has nothing to run until that is written.

per-player-in-a-chosen-direction.how: Landed: turn order to the left, its reverse after the first to the right (Order of Succession).

per-player-instruction-with-several-step.how: Its only cards are a plane (Kharasha Foothills) and a vanguard (Tradewind Rider Avatar): Cantrip's CardType has no Plane, Phenomenon or Vanguard, so neither card can be defined; the walk itself is not what holds them.
per-player-instruction-with-several-step.note: Spell Queller and the others landed earlier; what is left is held by card types Cantrip lacks.
per-player-instruction-with-several-step.partial: The only limit: a suspension inside instruction. Steps that genuinely ask midway (a sacrifice whose replacement asks) are not one batch. Villainous cards here also need that row.

per-player-keyword-each.how: Landed: each player turns face up their own cards exiled with it (Pyxis of Pandemonium).

per-player-manifest.how: "Up to two target players each manifest two cards from their hands" (Kozilek, the Broken Reality): all at once (CR 701.40a, 101.4), each under its own controller; put_all_onto_battlefield_face_down takes one controller, and one call per player would let the first manifest see the next enter (CR 603.6a). Needs a face-down entry of rows (object, controller), as put_all_onto_battlefield_as has.

per-player-mill.how: Landed: "for each opponent, you mill a card, then return it unless that player pays" is each opponent's whole process in turn (Sivriss); a walk where you act for them first, not "each opponent sacrifices unless they pay" (Rishadan Brigand keeps its steps, CR 101.4).

per-player-move-under-each-player-s-cont.how: Landed for cards in their own zone said of all zones (Second Sunrise). Thieves' Auction stays: a chosen card that can't enter stays exiled and the AST's repeat would never end; its rulings need the pick restricted to what can enter. Indomitable Creativity and Pyxis hold on other holes.
per-player-move-under-each-player-s-cont.note: Its only card left, Indomitable Creativity, is hand-written in Cantrip; lane g16 left it.
per-player-move-under-each-player-s-cont.partial: The only limit: a suspension inside instruction. Steps that genuinely ask midway (a sacrifice whose replacement asks) are not one batch. Villainous cards here also need that row.

per-player-players-do.how: Landed: "repeat the following process for each opponent in turn order" is a walk in which "that player" is the walked one (Protection Racket); walks of opponents now go in turn order, not seat order.

per-player-players-pay-repeatedly.how: Landed: a walk of players who pay repeatedly (Fade Away).

per-player-put-counters.how: Ask every player first into locals in a loop, then one batched call: g.sacrifice_each(&[(player,id)]), g.discard_together, g.move_together, g.put_all_onto_battlefield*, g.create_tokens_together, g.create_token_copies_together, g.create_tokens_attacking; or instruction(g, |g| ...) around question-free steps.

per-player-put-counters.partial: The only limit: a suspension inside instruction. Steps that genuinely ask midway (a sacrifice whose replacement asks) are not one batch. Villainous cards here also need that row.

per-player-sacrifice-all-but.how: Batched by Part::Once. A player who loses nothing is not asked, and at keep 0 nothing is asked: the Balance scenarios prove it. 'Chooses up to two' (Covetous Elegy) keeps as many as can, not exact: hole stays.
per-player-sacrifice-all-but.note: Tracker misread: the choice falls before the batch, not between. proposed begin_batch is unnecessary.

per-player-tapped-token-copies-of-severa.how: Engine: 'for each opponent, create a tapped token that's a copy of the exiled card attacking that opponent', where what it copies is a list (the cards exiled with it), is one creation of tapped copies of several originals: create_token_copies_together makes none tapped (game.rs:813) and create_token_copies_tapped takes one Copiable (game.rs:816), and a call for each original would make a batch of each (CR 603.2c). Needs a tapped flag on create_token_copies_together. Mardu Siegebreaker; its inner creation is the tapped-token-copies-of-several-objects-at-once gap.

per-player-tokens-entering-attached.how: Engine: a token created attached to an object each player's turn chose ('create a token that's a copy of Arrest and attach it to a creature that player controls chosen at random') has no call: put_onto_battlefield_attached takes an existing object (game.rs:762), and create_token_copies / create_tokens take no host (game.rs:806, 834). Peacekeeper Avatar, a vanguard Cantrip doesn't play (vocab.rs:489); its inner creation is tokens-entering-in-a-special-state.

play-permission-for-a-number-of-cards.note: Aminatou's Augury: one per card type (one: true has no kinds). Whispersteel Dagger: another player's graveyard.

play-permission-for-another-cost.note: Hama: 'waterbending {X}' from exile: PlayGrant.instead is a ManaCost; waterbend's tap-to-pay is a way only (row 60).

play-permission-for-lands-from-the-top-o.partial: LibraryTopSpells has the filter for the spell half.

play-permission-from-a-hand-once-each-tu.how: Vision: spell_alternatives: SpellAlternative{applies: hand, your turn, noncreature or Robot, !history::permission_used_this_turn; cost: WithoutPaying}, as Zaffai.

play-permission-from-every-graveyard.note: Coram: graveyard_play opens the caster's zone.

play-permission-from-exile-as-though-wit.how: Azula: exile_casts: ExileCast{any_type: true} plus flash_rules: fn(q, asker, card, player) true for the exiled-with cards on your turn.

play-permission-from-the-top-of-a-librar.note: Falco Spara, Into the Pit: an additional cost over the library top: LibraryTopSpells' second field is a replacement; ExileCast.additional is exile only.

play-permission-lasting-during-next-turn.how: Galvanic Relay: 'during your next turn, you may play that card' needs a permission that starts at that turn and lasts only through it. Expiry names only ends, later_turns would also allow opponents' turns in between, and PlayCondition has only AttackedWithThisTurn and ControlsSubtype. Needs Expiry::DuringYourNextTurn or a PlayCondition for the holder's turn.

play-permission-lasting-either.how: Temporal Aperture: 'until end of turn, for as long as that card remains on top of your library' is two ends at once; Expiry has one end and none of them is about the library's top (object.rs:1586). Needs an Expiry for 'while it stays on top', which duration-until-library-top-changes asks too.

play-permission-lasting-end-of-combat-on.note: Brazen Cannonade: no Expiry ends with a combat; Expiry::EndOfYourNextTurn runs too long, and PlayCondition is closed.

play-permission-lasting-until-another-ex.how: Add an Expiry that ends when another card is exiled with the same link (Expiry::UntilAnotherExiledWith(Linked)), or a way to take a PlayGrant back, so 'you may play that card until you exile another card with this' outlives the permanent as CR 611.2a has it. Expiry is closed (Never, EndOfTurn, EndOfYourNextTurn, UntilYourNextEndStep, WhileControls), PlayCondition is closed, allow_play cannot be revoked, and an ExileCast functions only while the permanent is on the battlefield.

play-permission-lasting-until-end-of-nex.how: Landed: Expiry::EndOfYourNextTurn when the permitted player is the one whose turn it names.
play-permission-lasting-until-end-of-nex.note: Expedited Inheritance (held on its data form).

play-permission-lasting-until-next.how: Casey & Raph landed (the holder's next end step is Expiry::UntilYourNextEndStep). Elkin Bottle and Grinning Totem: 'until the beginning of your next upkeep' has no Expiry (Never, EndOfTurn, EndOfYourNextTurn, UntilYourNextEndStep, WhileControls). Needs Expiry::UntilYourNextUpkeep.

play-permission-lasting-until-next-turn.note: Nivix, Memory Vessel: Expiry has no 'until your next turn' variant, and a PlayPermission cannot be revoked from a card. Add Expiry::UntilYourNextTurn. Memory Vessel also needs 'can't play from hand' for a while.
play-permission-lasting-until-next-turn.partial: Expiry::EndOfTurn is right on your own turn but ends sooner in a two-player game: an instant-speed use in an opponent's turn is the gap.

play-permission-lasting-while-on-battlef.how: Expiry has no 'while on the battlefield'; WhileControls is a different test (a stolen permanent would keep it). Intet, The Day of the Doctor.
play-permission-lasting-while-on-battlef.partial: Expiry::WhileControls also ends on a change of control, which 'remains on the battlefield' does not. ExileCast is exact but it can't take instead: ZERO; use a SpellAlternative beside it for Intet's free cast.

play-permission-of-one-card-of-each-perm.how: Muldrotha: permanent_type_used_this_turn doesn't exist, and a card of two types needs a record of which type it was played as.
play-permission-of-one-card-of-each-perm.partial: 'Choose one as you play it' for multi-type cards can't be asked at cast.

play-permission-on-a-condition.note: Boros Strike-Captain, Neriv, Summon: Brynhildr: the permanent may be gone by then, and PlayCondition is closed; PlayGrant is Copy + Hash so a fn is a change.

play-permission-on-an-open-set-of-cards.note: Sen Triplets, Shaman's Trance: other players' zones. The Great Work is the same (also counts: see note). Storybook Ride: attractions.

play-permission-on-other-terms.note: Xanathar: permission on another player's library top, open set; PlayRule::LibraryTop rules are own-library.
play-permission-on-other-terms.partial: allow_play(top card, any_type) reaches one card, not 'the top card whenever it changes'.

play-permission-one.how: Landed (lane g10): 'each [cards] in your graveyard gains "You may play this card from your graveyard" until end of turn' is `g.allow_play(card, owner, PlayGrant { lands, expiry: EndOfTurn, ..CAST })` for the cards there as it resolves (CR 611.2c), as Case of the Uneaten Feast is written. Kethis, the Hidden Hand is whole and compiles.

play-permission-to-play-land.note: Sen Triplets: a land permission skips any card in a hand (actions.rs:5453), so an opponent's lands can't be played, and object.rs says no card casts from another hand. Shaman's Trance: PlayFromGraveyard opens the caster's own graveyard only; open set of other players' graveyards.
play-permission-to-play-land.partial: For Shaman's Trance's spells, allow_play per card covers those there now.

play-permission-with-an-effect-on-what-i.how: The audit's how is wrong for most. Urianger needs a reduction PlayGrant lacks, Kaldring needs enters_tapped which is lands only (z.reason == PlayLand), Tomb of Aclazotz needs spell_replacement which only GrantedWay has. Each now names its own engine hole. Fires of Mount Doom, Apple and Ruinous are a delayed trigger reading the played card and stay as they were.

play-permission-with-mana-as-though-any-.how: PlayGrant/ExileCast any_type lets colored mana pay {C}, and all 23 cards print 'any color' over cards an opponent owns or a library holds, so any card with {C} in its cost plays wrong. It cannot be narrowed by a per-card test either: for such a card any_type: false is too narrow. Cantrip has no any-color field on a permission; spend_any_color is a battlefield rule that dies with its source. Only Robber of the Rich (hand-written) spells any color as any_type, and that is itself a deviation.
play-permission-with-mana-as-though-any-.partial: Any type is wider than any color only on {C} symbols: colored mana would pay {C}. Exact only with a permanent's spend_any_color rule, which needs it to stay on the battlefield.

play-permission-with-one-mana-as-though-.note: Abstruse Appropriation, Draugr Necromancer: PlayGrant cannot say which mana.

player-collection-damage-recipients.how: 'Those opponents' of a 'one or more' trigger are the players its batch's damage went to, and a batch keeps only object subjects as its members (settle.rs adds `Target::Object` subjects alone; `event_objects` and `TriggerMembers` are objects). Cantrip needs the batch's players kept too, e.g. `Query::event_players(item)` from the player subjects or `data[1]` of the batch's events. `batch_by_data` would split it into a trigger for each opponent, which is not one trigger (CR 603.2c).
player-collection-damage-recipients.note: Screaming Nemesis (the old evidence) is about the damaged creature, not a batch's recipients.

player-collection-damaged-by.how: Landed by lane g13: the players an instant or sorcery that deals damage once dealt damage to are read from its Damage events, as history::permanents_dealt_damage_by reads the permanents (history.rs:341). Aurelia's Fury holds on player-rule-for-a-while-can-t-cast-some-spells.

player-keyword-protection.note: PlayerProtectionRule is protection from a player; these need a quality.

player-reference-acting.how: Landed where it is the payer asked (Seizures, Braids's Frightful Return). Nothing else reads it.
player-reference-acting.partial: Noted-for across turns (Nihiloor): a value on a permanent: gap.

player-reference-affected.how: Landed where the rule's function has the player: a banned spell's filter (Lavinia), a permission from exile (Ian Malcolm), and "from your hand" in a play or cast ban, the hand of the player asked (Experimental Frenzy). Bosium Strip stays: a lasting permission to cast from the top of a graveyard has no call.
player-reference-affected.note: Lane g14: no card holds it. Heartwood Storyteller Avatar: a spell cost rule's filter reads the casting player (`player` of cost_changes) as the player the rule is about. Gwenom and The Belligerent now name their real holes: a-lasting-rule-to-look-at-the-top-card-of-a-library and a-lasting-permission-to-play-from-the-top-of-a-library.

player-reference-as-of.how: Glyph of Reincarnation: who controlled a creature the last time it became blocked by a Wall is no read of the history.
player-reference-as-of.partial: Noted-for across turns (Nihiloor): a value on a permanent: gap.

player-reference-bound.how: 'When each opponent casts their first spell of the game' is a delayed trigger made for each opponent, whose `matches` must know that opponent; a delayed trigger keeps a `subject`, but `matches` is asked with only the source and controller (`Asker`), and `Delayed::watched` turns a player subject into the source. Cantrip needs the subject passed to a delayed ability's `matches`, or the generator could make one rest-of-game delayed trigger that judges each opponent's first spell. Chancellor of the Annex also waits on a-reveal-from-an-opening-hand, which Cantrip lacks (OpeningHandAction only begins a card on the battlefield).

player-reference-clash-opponent.how: Clash has no module (no clash.rs in cantrip-mechanics); the opponent clashed with is the new module's result: a plain function clash in cantrip-mechanics returning whether you won and with whom, as operation-clash's how says. Lands with operation-clash.

player-reference-defending-player.how: Landed, but the audit's reading of it was too narrow: outside combat a state condition has no one defending player, and CR 508.5a makes it any opponent of the active player. Nuka-Nuke Launcher still holds on rad-counters and an event trigger.
player-reference-defending-player.note: Lane g16 did not land it (out of time); the read sits inside other holes of the same card. Nuka-Nuke Launcher holds on rad counters and an event trigger for until-end-of-next-turn.

player-reference-first-willing.how: Landed, but Vexing Devil's source reads any player while the card prints any opponent; an upstream data bug.
player-reference-first-willing.partial: Noted-for across turns (Nihiloor): a value on a permanent: gap.

player-reference-in-chosen-direction.how: Engine: a direction chosen by a resolving ability and kept ('attack only the nearest opponent in a direction chosen' as Mystic Barrier and Teyo choose it) is stored nowhere: Choices keeps only as-enters values (object.rs:225) and no state holds a direction. Pramikon's as-enters choice could be read with chosen_option (state.rs:1084), but its read sits in the player-rule-attack-only gap and a-choice-of-direction.

player-reference-named.how: The Toymaker's Trap: the player named is read from a secret choice (a-value-chosen-in-secret, operation-guess): Cantrip keeps no hidden answer, so nothing names that player yet.

player-reference-noted-for.how: Nihiloor: a reflexive trigger per opponent reading what was tapped for that opponent has nothing to carry it.
player-reference-noted-for.partial: Noted-for across turns (Nihiloor): a value on a permanent: gap.

player-reference-one-of.note: Activated abilities and spells cannot have an opponent pick a target at announcement. In a two-player game "an opponent" is one player, so several pass by card code there.
player-reference-one-of.partial: subject_chooses_targets is a TriggeredDef field (ability.rs:733 refuses otherwise); choose::player works in enters and resolution.

player-reference-other-chosen.how: Not landed: Sower of Discord holds on a-choice-of-several-values.
player-reference-other-chosen.partial: Encoding by hand: no hand-written card writes chosen_number directly, and anything showing choices shows a raw number. Choices made after entry are not covered.

player-reference-performer.how: Locals in the resolving function, in APNAP order.

player-reference-prior.how: Illicit Auction, Mages' Contest, Pain's Reward: the winning bidder is the result of a bid no module writes (operation-bid, a new module function in cantrip-mechanics); Laquatus's Champion and Soul Scourge: a player remembered from an enters trigger to a leaves trigger, which needs a note no Cantrip store keeps (as numeric-expression-noted); Yurlok's 'that player' in a rule as mana empties, which holds on player-rule-as-mana-empties (Cantrip). None can be written before its source.

player-reference-sole-target-of.how: Landed: the spell's stack item (or left_stack) is found by its object, and its targets are all Target::Player(first), as ObjectRef::SoleTargetOf reads the one object (q.sole_target_player, which the planned code called, does not exist). Zevlor compiles with its other holes stubbed and stays held by operation CopyOnStack and new targets EachPlayer.

player-rule-cant-be-caused.how: The Master, Multiplied: 'triggered abilities you control can't cause you to sacrifice or exile creature tokens you control'. CauseRule is fn(q, asker, causer, player, CauseKind), told neither the permanents nor whether the cause is a triggered ability, and CauseKind has no Exile. Needs CauseRule to get the cause's stack item and the objects. Ashiok, Dream Render is a data bug: by is Not(ControlledBy(Affected)), the reverse of 'your opponents control ... their controller'. Once the data is fixed, cause_rules with CauseKind::Search writes it, as ashiok_dream_render.rs:9 does.

With that change the delayed trigger carries the one creature as its subject and the form is gone (rendered); Dance of the Dead is then held only by enchant-graveyard-card and an-aura-that-enchants-what-it-put-onto-the-battlefield.
