room-door-with-replacement-effects.note: CardDef::door_unsupported refuses such a door when the table is built.

room-door-with-static-abilities.note: CardDef::door_unsupported refuses such a door when the table is built.

sacrifice-cost-without-a-fixed-count.how: Generator writes it (lane g6); landed and checked in Cantrip 01aba4b15: a spell's additional "sacrifice half the lands you control, rounded up" is cost_of_targets returning Cost::sacrifice((lands + 1) / 2, land), read as the total cost is determined (CR 601.2f), as Urgent Necropsy's is.

sacrificing-all-of-a-kind-of-permanent-a.partial: permanents has fixed count; SacrificeX asks.

sacrificing-any-number-of-permanents-to-.note: Emrakul's Evangel, Sword of the Ages: as row 54.

sacrificing-x-permanents-to-activate-an-.note: activate() announces only loyalty, RemoveAnyNumberOfCounters and {X}; SacrificeX is announced only in the spell path (extra.variable). Firecat Blitz: a way's cost also isn't. One fix here covers rows 57, 98, 124, 145, 146, 147 as well.

scavenge-cost-other-than-mana.note: Varolz, Young Deathclaws, The Cave of Skulls, Cursecloth Wrappings, Naktamun: see row 11: an activated ability's Cost is a constant, and GrantedWay only casts.

search-constraint-at-random.how: Its only cards are Vanguard avatars (Enigma Sphinx Avatar, Higure, the Still Wind Avatar). CardType has no Vanguard and Cantrip has no vanguard layout (layout-vanguard). A search 'at random' would be a SelectFn part once those cards exist.

search-constraint-common-property.how: Landed: 'that share a land type' is select::set_part with a SelectFn and a LargestFn over SubtypeSet::LAND_TYPES, as select::SHARE_A_CARD_TYPE (Myriad Landscape, whose 3 scenarios pass on the generated code).

search-constraint-different-names.how: No card holds on it any more. Ecological Appreciation, its last card, moved to the-chosen-cards-of-a-search-of-more-than-the-library-shuffled-into-it-read-as-a-shuffle-in-the-data, and once the data is fixed its DifferentNames search generates.

search-constraint-named-after-one-each.how: SelectFn can't capture a runtime list, and searching in sequence would change what triggers on a search.
search-constraint-named-after-one-each.partial: Random and named-after need code on top.

search-constraint-one-for-each.how: Landed. 'A land card of each basic land type' becomes one find clause per type, up to one each, through search_several. Gaea's Balance is whole.

search-with-cards-from-outside-the-game.how: Turtles Forever searches the library and outside the game as one selection: `searched_cards` and `outside_the_game` shown together, a library card moved, one from outside brought in with `bring_into_hand_revealed`. Add the graveyard to the same pool.
search-with-cards-from-outside-the-game.note: Lane g16 did not land it (out of time); the read sits inside other holes of the same card. Invasion of Arcavios is also held by condition-searched (gap: 'if you search your library this way' over a library, graveyard and outside-the-game search).

search-with-several-find-clauses.how: Landed for 'your graveyard, hand and/or library' too. search_as_one takes several find clauses there and makes one choice judged by clauses_verdict (select::part) over the zones searched. The library is included only if the searcher says yes (library::ask_may_search), and the shuffle follows that answer ('if you search your library this way'). Agency Outfitter is whole and compiles in the Cantrip tree. A 'may' over a search of other zones too is no longer gated by Game::may_search, so under Ashiok, Dream Render the other zones are still searched. This changes the code of 28 whole cards such as Ajani's Aid and Mishra, Artificer Prodigy.
search-with-several-find-clauses.note: Agency Outfitter compiled with its content file from new-card.py, but no scenarios were written. condition-searched no longer holds Agency Outfitter, because the condition reads searched_1.

selection-constraint-no-common-property.how: Not landed and not examined card by card this pass, so this verdict is unverified. Audit said: Card-written select::part, n=COUNTED.
selection-constraint-no-common-property.note: No cards left. Lane g16 fixed the lowering g13 found: DifferentNames reduces to SelectionConstraint::DifferentNames (select::DIFFERENT_NAMES), RevealNumberGroupCardsFromOutsideGame is a choice then a reveal of it, "exactly two" is two or nothing, and PutACardFromOutsideGameInHand(TheCardsFromOutsideGameChosenThisWay) moves the opponent's pick, not a fresh card. Extrapolate the Impossible compiles in Cantrip 01aba4b15; its scenarios are written for the hand-written prompt order (one card, then its partner, no separate 'may'): with that order adjusted, extrapolate-the-impossible-reveals-two-and-puts-the-opponents-pick-into-hand passes. With one card outside the game it still asks the 'may' and lets the player pick one card, which then does nothing, where the hand-written asks nothing.

selection-constraint-total-property.how: Generator writes it (lane g6); landed and checked in Cantrip 01aba4b15: Smelting Vat: select::total_mana_value_at_most(n) with n read at resolution.

selection-constraint-unpicked.how: Generator writes it (lane g6); landed and checked in Cantrip 01aba4b15: Manifold Insights: each opponent chooses among the cards no earlier opponent chose (a walk-wide unpicked list).

several-objects-arriving-attached.how: Not exact for Bruna, Evershrike, Flickerform, Mantle of the Ancients, Unfinished Business.
several-objects-arriving-attached.partial: They enter unattached for a moment: "enchanted" triggers and CR 303.4f choice timing differ; truly together only with one host call each.

several-objects-arriving-in-a-state.how: Generator writes it (lane g6); landed and checked in Cantrip 01aba4b15: Noctis: put_all_onto_battlefield_with_counters (tapped), then enter_attacking for each with its controller's defender (CR 508.4).

several-objects-entering-with-a-color.how: Ever After returns creatures that enter as Zombies in addition to their other colors and types; EntersAs has no colors field and there is no EffectKind that adds a color (SetColors only replaces), so put_all_onto_battlefield_becoming cannot say black in addition.
several-objects-entering-with-a-color.note: Ever After only; same need as engine-no-effect-adds-colors.

sharing-mana-values.how: The held test reads Chars::mana_value, which does not exist: a mana value belongs to the object (Query::mana_value), a spell's with its X. Proved both ways on Counterbalance.

shuffle-around-cards-that-stay-where-the.how: Landed. Exact only where the cards left out are the ones moved next, which the generator checks.

skipping-a-step-of-the-turn.note: Skipping a turn exists; a step, no.

snow-mana-spent.how: obj.spent.snow does not exist, and the audit's mana_told_apart on the card does not work: it is asked only of battlefield permanents, so a spell in hand tells nothing apart. Held code corrected, 6 cards under 'engine: snow mana told apart as a spell is paid for'.
snow-mana-spent.partial: mana_told_apart was read as a battlefield permanent's: for a spell in hand payment may not distinguish. Not confirmed. Tundra Fumarole's lingering mana: add_mana_until_end_of_turn.

source-zone-scope-on-casting.how: Landed. A way has one condition, so the 'as long as' and the requirement share one function: Viral Spawning, proved by a scenario.

source-zone-scope-on-conditional.how: Rewriting a condition inside a Scoped ability to the scope's own gate lands the 5 Surveyors, proved on Goblin Surveyor. Lightwheel Enhancements is a gap: the audit's 'condition' on a way makes an alternative cost of a card's own permission.

source-zone-scope-on-counts-as-named.how: Landed, as the audit said: nothing goes on Diligent Farmhand or Pardic Firecat. Muscle Burst and Flame Burst now count them. Before this they were whole and still missed them, a deviation. Proved with Muscle Burst.

source-zone-scope-on-replacement.note: Dearly Departed, Retriever Phoenix: ReplacementDef.own_everywhere is its own events; replacements are read from the battlefield.

source-zone-scope-on-static.note: The Ur-Dragon, The Ur-Sphinx: eminence from the command zone: cost_changes come from the battlefield: static_rules::sources.

spell-cost-increase-other-than-mana.note: Drought: sacrifices: CostDelta holds mana and life only.

spell-cost-rule-with-terms.note: Five Defilers, Chorus of the Conclave: an optional payment on another spell's cast: CostDelta::life is not optional.

splice-onto-cost-other-than-mana.note: Horobi's Whisper, Hundred-Talon Strike, Roar of Jukai, Torrent of Stone, Veil of Secrecy: CardDef.splice is Option<ManaCost>: this one is true. Roar of Jukai also has an opponent gaining life.

squad-cost-other-than-mana.how: multikicker_cost as the audit said; Cost::times multiplies discards as it does exile. Ruthless Radrat replaces the hand-written card with its scenarios passing.

static-change-add-names.note: SetName sets one name; Chars has no second.

static-change-chosen-ability.how: Landed: 'choose two abilities from among first strike, vigilance, and lifelink' as it enters is one choice of the 3 sets of two, each one of the card's labels ('first strike and vigilance', ...), made with choose::option_as_enters and kept as chosen_option (CR 607.2f, 614.12a); the static reads chosen_option through linked_to and grants that set's Keywords (q.chosen_abilities, which the planned code called, does not exist). Greymond is whole and its scenario passes.
static-change-chosen-ability.partial: Encoding by hand: no hand-written card writes chosen_number directly, and anything showing choices shows a raw number. Choices made after entry are not covered.

static-change-colorless-damage-source.note: Ghostly Flame: damage reads the source colors; no mark for colorless.

static-change-copy-of.partial: Copy is at layer 1 by become_copy on an effect, no static form.

static-change-creature-types-of.how: Data: the AST's LastExiled isn't 'the last creature card exiled' on Duplicant, so a type layer can't read it. Held.

static-change-gain-abilities-of.how: Landed for cards and once each turn: grant_activated_abilities_of(view, &cards, chars), and "activate each of those abilities only once each turn" is CardDef::granted_once_each_turn counting the asked objects whose card is the ability's (Mairsil, the Pretender; Locus of Enlightenment, whose "exiled cards used to craft it" are craft::used_to_craft, linked to the card that waited in exile and not to an ability of Locus). Drana and Linvala (permanents' abilities plus spend as any color), Scheming Fence, Koh and Sharkey stay held on other parts.
static-change-gain-abilities-of.note: Lane g14: no card holds it. Idris: "all activated and triggered abilities of the exiled card" is each such ability its card prints in the object's slots (the core reads triggered abilities from Chars::abilities as it does activated ones). Clandestine Chameleon and Pin Collection: the-abilities-of-ability-stickers.

static-change-replace-word.note: EffectKind::ChangeText is a resolved effect on one object.

static-change-set-controller.how: control_changing only gives control to the source's controller: Fealty to the Realm.

static-change-text-of.partial: Copy is at layer 1 by become_copy on an effect, no static form.

static-play-permission-with-an-effect-on.note: Advanced Floral Invocations, Mischievous Lookout: perpetual (Alchemy).

static-rule-activations-each-turn.partial: Boast is a flat once_each_turn; extra_power_up_activations is power-up only. Birgi needs that for boast.

static-rule-assign-damage-to.partial: attacker_division offers no division with no blockers and no way to assign to a creature not in combat with it.

static-rule-attach-only-to.note: Partly writable: equip(..).targets(filter) handles the common case.
static-rule-attach-only-to.partial: A filter on the Equip ability covers Equip alone. Other attach effects and the 704.5n check go through host_allows, which reads no rule of the Equipment.

static-rule-attack-drags.partial: Attack requirements come from Chars::must_attack and effects, and are unconditional; none depends on who else is declared. attack_rules forbid one pair.

static-rule-attack-exception.how: Gap: AttackDespiteDefenderRule is fn(q, asker, creature) with no defender, so "can attack players who attacked you during their last turn as though it didn't have defender" can't name the players. Pairing it with an attack rule that forbids the others is wrong with another despite-defender effect (Rolling Stones lets Walls attack anyone).
static-rule-attack-exception.note: The despite rule has no target argument, so the two tables work together.

static-rule-attack-exception-summoning-s.note: AttackRule only forbids; summoning sickness is checked in core.

static-rule-attacks-when-attacking.partial: As static-rule-attack-drags: a requirement conditional on the declaration has no form.

static-rule-block-capacity.note: blocks.rs rejects a second block with "can block only one creature" (509.1a). BlockRequirements has per-attacker limits and no per-blocker one. Verified after doubt; this one was the most likely misread and it is not one.

static-rule-block-while-tapped.note: blocks.rs candidates exclude tapped creatures; no rule list widens it.

static-rule-blocked-by-defender.how: block_rules testing attacker against what q.controller(blocker) controls: Graxiplon, Tanglewalker.

static-rule-blocks-despite.partial: can_block hard-codes flying, shadow and landwalk, then runs block_rules, which can only forbid. Giving the blocker Shadow would stop it blocking everything else, so no card-side form exists.

static-rule-blocks-only-if.how: Rule::BlocksOnlyIf does not exist; a block_rules function does it. Attacking player is the active player (506.2).

static-rule-cant-attack-defender-if.how: An attack rule function reading defending_player_of the attack, not the attacker's current defender, which has none as attacks are declared.
static-rule-cant-attack-defender-if.partial: The same cards' "can't block ..." halves are block_rules.

static-rule-cant-gain-ability.partial: No rule table for it, and a Layer::Ability removal runs in timestamp order, so a later grant wins. "Can't have or gain" needs a lock past timestamps.

static-rule-combat-cost-block.note: No block_costs: attack_costs is a fn to Option<ManaCost> read at declare attackers; BlockRule only says yes or no. Hollow Warrior taps a creature: also row 68. Archangel of Tithes, Awesome Presence, Cowed by Wisdom, Heat Wave, Hipparion, Myr Prototype, Oppressive Rays, Qal Sisma Behemoth, Whipgrass
static-rule-combat-cost-block.partial: The attack half of 'can't attack or block unless' is attack_costs.

static-rule-combat-damage-as-unblocked.note: turn.rs assignment reads Keyword/rule of the blocked attacker; nothing asks a rule list, and CardDef has no field for it.

static-rule-combat-group-attacker.partial: Per-creature AttackRule and per-target AttackLimitRule; blocked-by-count limits cover one attacker only.

static-rule-combat-group-blocked-attacke.partial: Per-creature AttackRule and per-target AttackLimitRule; blocked-by-count limits cover one attacker only.

static-rule-combat-group-blocker.partial: Per-creature AttackRule and per-target AttackLimitRule; blocked-by-count limits cover one attacker only.

static-rule-counter-limit.how: Rasputin Dreamweaver: 'can't have more than seven dream counters on it'. CounterBan is fn(q, asker, object, controller, kind) -> bool, all or nothing for a put, so a put of two onto one with six (a doubled put) can't come out as one, and nothing caps a put at what is left. Needs a counter limit, (kind, most) read where counters are put, or a CounterBan told the amount that returns what may be put. The card also holds on object-state-started-turn-untapped.

static-rule-goaded-by.partial: chars.must_attack covers half of goad; "a player other than the goader" is read from EffectKind::Goaded only.

static-rule-may-exert.partial: Cantrip says so itself: a condition on AttackOption is not built; .condition would still offer and pay the exert.

static-rule-may-exert-with-nothing-linke.how: exert::as_it_attacks(no-op, 'You may exert...') for the offer, plus a triggered(when(EventMask::PAID_TO_ATTACK, fn)) on Event::PaidToAttack{option: AttackOption::Exert, ..} for 'whenever you exert a creature', as enlist does.
static-rule-may-exert-with-nothing-linke.partial: A no-op linked trigger shows on the stack. Exerts paid by a cost don't raise PaidToAttack: 'whenever you exert' misses Cost::exert. A silent AttackOption form would be cleaner.

static-rule-own-activation-cost.how: Landed: "This Equipment's equip ability costs {N} less to activate if it targets [a permanent]" is the equip ability's own .cost_change(fn), the target read as the total cost is determined, as ghostfire_blade.rs writes it. Generated Ghostfire Blade passes its scenario. Other shapes (several equip abilities, colored reductions, other ability filters) keep the static-rule-own-activation-cost hole.

static-rule-prohibit-activate.how: activation_rules is asked of a card in hand too: a creature card in hand is no creature, so a rule over the battlefield must test it is there, or Damping Matrix stops cycling.
static-rule-prohibit-activate.note: Forms overlap, so the row is 14 cards by 16 form memberships.

static-rule-prohibit-be-attached-by.partial: host_allows is closed: protection, then Equipment-creature or the Aura's enchant ability. Nothing on the host is asked. Protection from Auras would over-reach.

static-rule-prohibit-be-attacked.how: Landed: Layer::Ability static adding Keyword::CantBeAttacked, the keyword the attack rules read (The Aetherspark, whose scenarios pass on the generated code).

static-rule-prohibit-be-beamed-up.how: Landed: a CardDef::cost_bans entry matching CostPayment::BeamUp of the subject (Marooned, whose 6 scenarios pass on the generated code).

static-rule-prohibit-be-played.how: Null Chamber: 'you and an opponent each choose a card name ... spells with the chosen names can't be cast and lands with the chosen names can't be played'. The rule itself is a cast_rules and a land_play_rules entry (card.rs:3230), but a permanent keeps one name chosen as it enters (Entering::chosen_card, card.rs:86), and here two players choose two names. Needs a second chosen name, or a list of them, on the permanent. The card also holds on supertype-world.

static-rule-prohibit-counter-of-abilitie.note: The can't-be-countered keyword reaches spells only.

static-rule-prohibit-crew.how: activation_rules are asked of the Vehicle and CostPayment shows no tap, so a creature can't be barred from crewing.
static-rule-prohibit-crew.note: Forms overlap, so the row is 14 cards by 16 form memberships.

static-rule-prohibit-lose-counters.partial: counter_bans stops counters being put, not removed; remove_counters has no rule.

static-rule-prohibit-turn-face-up.how: activation_rules: &[fn] and crew is an activated ability; face_up_bans for turn-face-up.
static-rule-prohibit-turn-face-up.note: Forms overlap, so the row is 14 cards by 16 form memberships.

static-rule-require-combat-attack.how: chars.must_attack is an unaimed requirement. Must-attack-a-given-player has no static form: Galactus, Public Enemy.

static-rule-require-combat-be-blocked.note: block_requirements is exact only when a single creature of the kind can block.
static-rule-require-combat-be-blocked.partial: must_be_blocked(q,source,attacker) has no blocker kind and is satisfied by any blocker; block_requirements makes each able blocker required, too strict once two Eldrazi could block. "By two or more" (Gorm) has neither.

static-rule-require-combat-block.how: BlockRequirement is asked per attacker: a creature able to block two attackers is forced to double-block. The audit's 'counts differ only when two conflict' understated it.
static-rule-require-combat-block.note: Grand Melee, Invasion Plans, Iron Golem. Tracker says only effects can.
static-rule-require-combat-block.partial: One requirement per attacker rather than one for the creature; the counts differ only when two requirements conflict.

static-rule-tap-cost-uses-toughness.partial: The crew and saddle total reads c.power; damage_by_toughness governs combat damage only. Tapestry Warden's damage half is that table.

static-rule-tap-power-bonus.how: Audit named crew and saddle. Station reads the tapped creature's power with no keyword bonus: Stoic Star-Captain.
static-rule-tap-power-bonus.partial: Stoic Star-Captain's station half: station reads power in cantrip_mechanics::station with no bonus.

static-rule-targetable-despite.how: Both cards (Kaya, Bane of the Dead; Glaring Spotlight) say 'spells and abilities you control'. TargetingRule IgnoreHexproof's applies(q, source, object) names no targeter, so it lifts hexproof for every player's spells.
static-rule-targetable-despite.partial: Exact in a two-player game only.

static-rule-unique.note: Nacatl War-Pride alone exists: blocker_limits Some(1) plus must_be_blocked.
static-rule-unique.partial: Eight unrelated rules. Zilortha, Ogre Enforcer: lethal damage is obj.damage>=toughness with no hook. Skullbriar, Me: counters do not survive a move. Tromokratis: no "unless all block" rule on the declaration. Panglacial Wurm: no cast window inside a search. Ghostly Flame: damage reads the source's r

static-rule-untap-step.how: Its only cards are a plane (Horizon Boughs) and an ongoing scheme (I Know All, I See All), and CardType has neither (layout-planar, layout-scheme). The rule itself is a CardDef::untap_in_others_untap_steps entry once those cards exist.

static-subjects-matching.how: Landed: the subjects are (objects).contains(&id), read as they are now; the top card of a library is the zone's first (library.rs:1040). Both cards compile with their other holes stubbed, and both stay held by other forms: Fblthp by engine: no Plot granted, engine: no cost copies a mana cost, player rule KeywordAccess, Plot cost other than mana; Night Soil by engine: no set rule on what a cost chooses and move cost Exile from Matching.

static-subjects-one.how: Landed: the object chosen as the source entered is `q.state().chosen_object(linked) == Some(id)`, linked as the static's reader is (Tyrannical Pitlord). Scheming Fence still holds on GainAbilitiesOf.

static-subjects-take.how: Landed with resolution-cost-move: Triumph of Saint Katherine's top six are read as objects for the cost, not as a static's subjects, and the card is whole.

target-cardinality-exactly.how: Printed {X} (spell or activated): targets::X.between(0, TargetSpec::COUNTED) or .counted() for exactly X; Divide{total: TargetSpec::COUNTED} on a spell; of_x for "X plus 1". Triggered, count read from the game: .between(0,COUNTED).counted_by(fn(q,asker)->u32); event amount: .counted_by_amount(). Its last three cards are now on their own gap forms: Comet Storm and Strength of the Tajuru on a-spell-s-target-count-of-times-kicked-beside-an-x-or-added-to, Primitive Justice on a-spell-s-target-count-of-an-additional-cost-paid-any-number-of-times.

target-cardinality-exactly.partial: Spell/activated read-from-game via together: judged again at resolution (a changed count makes the whole slot illegal, guard it with a check that the item already has targets); players are not counted by together, so "any target" counts fail; not honoured with Divide. Proposed: SpellActions(Modal_ChooseUptoNumber(Integer(2), [Targeted([TargetGraveyardCard(And([IsCardtype(Artifact), InAPlayersGraveyard(SinglePlayer(You))]))], ActionList([])), ... one mode per card type ...])) with the return shared by the chosen modes, as call_damage_control.rs's ModalDef::shared(return_those_cards) does (the cards return together). target-reference.how: mtgish data: Sacred Boon (data/mtgish.lines.ron:23812) puts CreateFutureTrigger(AtTheBeginningOfTheNextEndStep, ..) inside the prevention shield's actions, [PreventThatDamage, CreateFutureTrigger(..)], so each prevented event would make a delayed trigger, and inside the shield's callback the spell's target is out of reach (the hole). Oracle makes one delayed trigger as the spell resolves. Proposed: ActionList([CreateFuturePreventDamage(NextAmountOfDamageThatWouldBeDealtThisTurnToRecipient(Integer(3), Permanent(Ref_TargetPermanent)), [PreventThatDamage]), CreateFutureTrigger(AtTheBeginningOfTheNextEndStep, ActionList([PutCounters([NumberCountersOfTypeOnPermanent(TheAmountOfDamagePreventedThisWay, PTCounter(+0, +1), Ref_TargetPermanent)])]))]). The delayed trigger then carries the target as its subject (Game::delayed_trigger's subject). Sacred Boon is also held by power/toughness counter other than ±1/±1 (Cantrip has no +0/+1 counter) and damage prevented by an effect of this ability.

the-activated-abilities-of-other-permane.how: Landed in the generator (lane_h gain_abilities_of): the layer-6 apply reads each other permanent through the view, which in layer 6 is the object as that layer's effects applied so far leave it (CR 613.8; dependencies judged on the objects read), and copies each AbilityRef of its abilities() whose ActivatedDef is no special action and passes the card's exceptions (is_mana_ability, is_loyalty_ability); itself and what left the battlefield excluded. 'You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to activate those abilities' is a spend_any_color rule for the activation costs of this permanent's abilities. All seven cards settle: Drana and Linvala, Scheming Fence, Experiment Kraj, Marvin, Robaran Mercenaries, Manascape Refractor land; Sharkey is held by mana-spent-as-though-of-any-type.

the-chosen-cards-of-a-search-of-more-tha.how: Ecological Appreciation: the AST says `SearchLibraryAndGraveyard([FindUptoNumberGroupCards(Integer(4), And([IsCardtype(Creature), ManaValueIs(LessThanOrEqualTo(ValueX))]), DifferentNames), RevealFoundCards, APlayerChoosesNumberFoundCards(Opponent, Integer(2)), SetAsideNonchosenFoundCards, Shuffle, PutSetAsideCardsOntoBattlefield([EntersNormally])])`. Oracle says 'Shuffle the chosen cards into your library', so the plain `Shuffle` should be an action that shuffles the chosen found cards into the library (for example `ShuffleChosenFoundCardsIntoLibrary`). Chosen cards found in the graveyard have to move. Once the data says so, the rest of the search (DifferentNames over library and graveyard, with an opponent choosing) generates.

Proposed: PermanentPassesFilter(Trigger_ThatLand, Not(IsFirstLandPlayedByPlayerThisTurn)). With it the existing S::FirstLandPlayedThisTurn read negated is what fastbond.rs's lands_played > 1 says, and the guard in lane_m.rs goes.

the-life-you-lose-read-as-the-revealing-.how: Jhoira, Weatherlight Corsair: the data puts LoseLife(ManaValueOfTheFoundCard) inside PlayerAction(Ref_TargetPlayer, RevealCardsFromTheTopOfLibraryUntil..., [PutTheCardFoundThisWayOntoTheBattlefield([EntersUnderPlayersControl(You)]), LoseLife(...), ...]), so the target opponent loses the life. The Oracle says 'You put that card onto the battlefield under your control and lose life equal to that permanent's mana value'. Proposed: move LoseLife out of the opponent's PlayerAction, acted by You, after the put.

Add the exiling player to ExileLink (set by exile_with / exile_face_down from the replacement's player), and a look permission for it.

the-rest-of-a-search-outside-the-game-sh.how: Data bug on Turtles Forever (hand-written): Oracle "... An opponent chooses two of them. Put the chosen cards into your hand and shuffle the rest into your library." The rest may be cards from outside the game, which go into the library; the data's last step is a plain Shuffle: SearchLibraryAndOrOutsideTheGame([FindExactlyNumberGroupCards(Integer(4), And([IsSupertype(Legendary), IsCardtype(Creature)]), DifferentNames), RevealFoundCards, APlayerChoosesNumberFoundCards(Opponent, Integer(2)), PutChosenFoundCardIntoHand, Shuffle]). Proposed: replace Shuffle with a step that shuffles the nonchosen found cards into the library (as turtles_forever.rs moves the rest with move_together_revealed to the library, then shuffles), the same fix as Ecological Appreciation's.

trigger-event-player-pays-life.how: Font of Agonies: 'whenever you pay life'. Life paid is recorded only as Event::LifeChange { player, delta } (event.rs:84). Its Record.cause is Cause::Player for a cost of the player's own action, but an ability's cause for 'you may pay 2 life' as it resolves (CR 119.4, 118.12), so no record says the life was paid. Needs Event::LifePaid { player, amount }, or a paid flag on LifeChange. The card also holds on numeric-expression-game.

trigger-event-player-taps-permanent.how: Event::Tapped has no player. Record::cause gives Cause::Ability{source, ability}, which names a source, not the ability's controller: an ability whose source changed control or left before it resolved reads wrong, and no card reads a tap's cause.

two-choices-of-labels-as-it-enters.how: Its only card is a plane (Two Streams Facility), and CardType has no Plane (layout-planar). chosen_option with chosen_number holding the second index would keep both choices once planes exist.

two-costs-a-spell-kicks-with.how: Lands as kicker + OptionalCost::new, proved by scenario on Archangel of Wrath, Anavolver, Stronghold Arena, Hallar. Audit missed three things: (1) every generated reader of 'kicked' and 'times kicked' on another object has to ask kicked || (paid && def.kicker), or Hallar misses it; (2) two conditional 'enters with' replacements overwrite Entering::becomes, so a Volver kicked twice lost the first kicker's keyword, needing a merged EntersAs; (3) Illuminate cannot land: X in a mana cost beside a kicker is never announced (actions.rs: if let Some(k) = def.kicker takes the one number).
two-costs-a-spell-kicks-with.note: object.rs:52 names this case: 'a card with kicker and another optional cost is not ambiguous'. No hand-written card spells it this way yet.
two-costs-a-spell-kicks-with.partial: 'Whenever you cast a kicked spell' and 'if it was kicked' mean kicked only, so the second cost, being paid, doesn't read as kicked: OptionalCost{kicker: true} would set kicked but lose which. A card reads both fields; shared readers need item.kicked + item.paid.

what-a-surveil-put-into-a-graveyard-of-a.how: Chandra, Chill of Compliance: 'If you put a noncreature, nonland card into your graveyard this way' is Earlier(PutInGraveyard, filter: Either([Not(Creature), Not(Land)])) in the AST, 'noncreature or nonland', where the Oracle text means both (All). The generator holds the line because of that (effects.rs, printed_otherwise 'nonland card into your graveyard'). With All, its surveil path already writes surveil_into_graveyard and filters what it returned, as the hand-written card does.
